forest.name: Closed Forest
description:
Determines if Kokiri Forest can be left for the Lost Woods bridge or the Deku Tree.

On - Kokiri Sword & Deku Shield are required to access 
the Deku Tree, and completing the Deku Tree is required to 
access the Lost Woods Bridge Exit.

Deku Only - Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path to the Bridge 
but Mido still requires the Kokiri Sword and Deku Shield to access the tree.

Off - Mido no longer blocks the path to the Deku Tree. Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path out of the forest.

door_of_time.name: Door of Time
description:
Closed - The Ocarina of Time, the Song of Time and all 
three Spiritual Stones are required to open the Door of Time.

Song only - Play the Song of Time in front of the Door of Time to open it.

Open - The Door of Time is permanently open with no requirements.

zoras_fountain.name: Zora's Fountain
description: Closed - King Zora obstructs the way to Zora's Fountain.
Ruto's Letter must be shown as child Link in order to move
him in both time periods.
Closed as child - Ruto's Letter is only required to move King Zora
as child Link. Zora's Fountain starts open as adult.
Open - King Zora has already mweeped out of the way in both
time periods. Ruto's Letter is removed from the item pool.

sleeping_waterfall.name: Sleeping Waterfall
description: Closed - Sleeping Waterfall obstructs the entrance to Zora's
Domain. Zelda's Lullaby must be played in order to open it
(but only once; then it stays open in both time periods).
Open - Sleeping Waterfall is always open. Link may always enter Zora's Domain.

jabu_open.name: Jabu-Jabu
description: Closed - A fish is required to open Jabu-Jabu's mouth.
Open - Jabu-Jabu's mouth opens without the need for a fish.

lock_overworld_doors.name: Lock Overworld Doors
lock_overworld_doors.description: Add locks to all wooden overworld doors, requiring specific small keys to open them

starting_age.name: Starting Age
description:
Choose which age Link will start as.

Starting as adult means you start with the Master Sword in your inventory.
The child option is forcefully set if it would conflict with other options.

gerudo_fortress.name: Fortress Carpenters
description:
Sets the state of the carpenters captured by Gerudo 
in Gerudo Fortress, and with it the number of guards that spawn.

Normal - All 4 carpenters are required to be saved.

Fast - Only the bottom left carpenter requires rescuing.

Free - Bridge is repaired from start, and Nabooru cannot spawn.
If the Gerudo Membership Card isn't shuffled, you start with it.

Only "Normal" is compatible with Gerudo Fortress Keyrings.

rainbow_bridge.name: Rainbow Bridge
description:
Alters the requirements to open the bridge to Ganon's Castle.

Vanilla - Obtain the Shadow Medallion, Spirit Medallion and Light Arrows.

Always open - No requirements.

Stones - Obtain the specified amount of Spiritual Stones.

Medallions - Obtain the specified amount of medallions.

Dungeon rewards - Obtain the specified total sum of Spiritual 
Stones or medallions.

Dungeons - Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons 
are considered complete after stepping into the blue warp after 
the boss.

Tokens - Obtain the specified amount of Skulltula tokens.

Greg - Find Greg the Green Rupee.

bridge_options.name: Bridge Reward Options
description:
Standard Rewards - Greg does not change logic, Greg does not help open the bridge, max 
number of rewards on slider does not change.

Greg as Reward - Greg does change logic (can be part of expected path for opening 
bridge), Greg helps open bridge, max number of rewards on slider increases by 1 to account for Greg.

Greg as Wildcard - Greg does not change logic, Greg helps open the bridge, max number of rewards on slider does not change.

ganons_trials.name: Ganon's Trials
description:
Sets the number of Ganon's Trials required to dispel the barrier.

Skip - No Trials are required and the barrier is already dispelled.

Set Number - Select a number of trials that will be required from the 
slider below. Which specific trials you need to complete will be random.

Random Number - A random number and set of trials will be required.

trial_count.name: Ganon's Trials Count
trial_count.description: Set the number of trials required to enter Ganon's Tower.

medallion_locked_trials.name: Medallion Locked Trials
medallion_locked_trials.description: Doors to trials will be barred until their corresponding medallion is acquired.

mq_dungeon_random.name: MQ Dungeon Setting
description:
Sets the number of Master Quest Dungeons that are shuffled into the pool.

None - All Dungeons will be their Vanilla versions.

Set Number - Select a number of dungeons that will be their Master Quest versions 
using the slider below. Which dungeons are set to be the Master Quest variety will be random.

Random Number - A random number and set of dungeons will be their Master Quest varieties.

Selection Only - Specify which dungeons are Vanilla, Master Quest or a 50/50 between the two.
Differs from Random Number in that they are rolled individually, making the exact total a bell curve.

mq_dungeon_set.name: Set Dungeon Quests
description: Choose specific Dungeons to be Master Quest or Vanilla.
If Master Quest Dungeons is set to Set Number or Random, the dungeons chosen
to be Master Quest here will count towards that total. Any Dungeons set to Vanilla
here will be guaranteed to be Vanilla. If Set Number is higher than the number of dungeons
set to either MQ or Random here, you will have fewer MQ Dungeons than the number you set.

triforce_hunt_pieces_total.name: Triforce Hunt Total Pieces
description: The number of Triforce pieces that will be placed in the world. Set to 0 to disable Triforce Hunt.
Triforce Pieces can be used as a requirement for the Rainbow Bridge, Ganon's Boss Key, Ganon's Soul, or the
win condition. Keep in mind seed generation can fail if more pieces are placed than there are junk items in
the item pool.

wincon_triforce_count.name: Win Condition Triforce Piece Count
wincon_triforce_count.description: The number of Triforce pieces required to win the game.

triforce_hunt_pieces_location.name: Triforce Hunt Pieces Location
description:
Any dungeon - Triforce pieces can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Triforce pieces can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Triforce pieces can appear anywhere in the world.

shuffle_dungeon_entrances.name: Dungeon Entrances
description:
Shuffle the pool of dungeon entrances, including Bottom of the Well, Ice Cavern and Gerudo Training Ground.

Shuffling Ganon's Castle can be enabled separately.

Additionally, the entrances of Deku Tree, Fire Temple, Bottom of the Well and Gerudo Training Ground are 
opened for both child and adult.

- Deku Tree will be open for adult after Mido has seen child Link with a sword and a shield.
- Bottom of the Well will be open for adult after playing Song of Storms to the Windmill guy as child.
- Gerudo Training Ground will be open for child after adult has paid to open the gate once.

shuffle_boss_entrances.name: Boss Entrances
description:
Shuffle the pool of dungeon boss entrances. This affects the boss rooms of all stone and medallion dungeons.

Age Restricted - Shuffle the entrances of child and adult boss rooms separately.

Full - Shuffle the entrances of all boss rooms together. Child may be expected to defeat Phantom Ganon and/or 
Bongo Bongo.

shuffle_ganons_tower_entrance.name: Ganon's Tower Entrance
description: Shuffle the entrance from Ganon's Castle to Ganon's Tower into the pool of boss entrances.

shuffle_overworld_entrances.name: Overworld Entrances
description:
Shuffle the pool of Overworld entrances, which corresponds to almost all loading zones between overworld areas.

Some entrances are unshuffled to avoid issues:
- Hyrule Castle Courtyard and Garden entrance
- Both Market Back Alley entrances
- Gerudo Valley to Lake Hylia (unless entrances are decoupled)

shuffle_interior_entrances.name: Interior Entrances
description:
Shuffle the pool of interior entrances which contains most Houses and all Great Fairies.

All - An extended version of 'Simple' with some extra places:
- Windmill
- Link's House
- Temple of Time
- Kakariko Potion Shop

shuffle_thieves_hideout_entrances.name: Thieves' Hideout Entrances
shuffle_thieves_hideout_entrances.description: Shuffle the pool of entrances between Gerudo Fortress & Thieves' Hideout.

shuffle_grotto_entrances.name: Grottos Entrances
shuffle_grotto_entrances.description: Shuffle the pool of grotto entrances, including all graves, small Fairy fountains and the Deku Theatre.

shuffle_owl_drops.name: Owl Drops
shuffle_owl_drops.description: Randomize where Kaepora Gaebora (the Owl) drops you when you talk to him at Lake Hylia or at the top of Death Mountain Trail.

shuffle_warp_songs.name: Warp Songs
shuffle_warp_songs.description: Randomize where each of the 6 warp songs leads to.

shuffle_overworld_spawns.name: Overworld Spawns
description:
Randomize where you start as Child or Adult when loading a save in the Overworld. This 
means you may not necessarily spawn inside Link's House or Temple of Time.

This stays consistent after saving and loading the game again.

Keep in mind you may need to temporarily disable the "Remember Save Location" time saver to 
be able to use the spawn positions, especially if they are the only logical way to get to certain areas.

decoupled_entrances.name: Decouple Entrances
description: Decouple entrances when shuffling them. This means you are no longer guaranteed
to end up back where you came from when you go back through an entrance.
This also adds the one-way entrance from Gerudo Valley to Lake Hylia in the pool of
overworld entrances when they are shuffled.

mixed_entrance_pools.name: Mixed Entrance Pools
description: Shuffle entrances into a mixed pool instead of separate ones. Has no effect on pools whose
entrances aren't shuffled, and "Shuffle Boss Entrances" must be set to "Full" to include them.
For example, enabling the settings to shuffle grotto, dungeon, and overworld entrances and
selecting grotto and dungeon entrances here will allow a dungeon to be inside a grotto or
vice versa, while overworld entrances are shuffled in their own separate pool and indoors stay vanilla.

mix_dungeon_entrances.name: Mix Dungeons
mix_dungeon_entrances.description: Dungeon entrances will be part of the mixed pool.

mix_boss_entrances.name: Mix Bosses
mix_boss_entrances.description: Boss entrances will be part of the mixed pool.

mix_overworld_entrances.name: Mix Overworld
mix_overworld_entrances.description: Overworld entrances will be part of the mixed pool.

mix_interior_entrances.name: Mix Interiors
mix_interior_entrances.description: Interior entrances will be part of the mixed pool.

mix_grotto_entrances.name: Mix Grottos
mix_grotto_entrances.description: Grotto entrances will be part of the mixed pool.

shuffle_songs.name: Shuffle Songs
description:
Off - Songs will appear at their vanilla locations.

Song locations - Songs will only appear at locations that normally teach songs.

Dungeon rewards - Songs appear after beating a major dungeon boss.
The 4 remaining songs are located at:
  - Zelda's Lullaby location
  - Ice Cavern's Serenade of Water location
  - Bottom of the Well Lens of Truth location
  - Gerudo Training Ground's Ice Arrows location

Anywhere - Songs can appear at any location.

shuffle_tokens.name: Token Shuffle
description:
Shuffles Golden Skulltula Tokens into the item pool. This means 
Golden Skulltulas can contain other items as well.

Off - GS tokens will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle GS tokens that are within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle GS tokens that are outside of dungeons.

All Tokens - Shuffle all 100 GS tokens.

skulls_suns_song.name: Night Skulltula's Expect Sun's Song
skulls_suns_song.description: All Golden Skulltulas that require nighttime to appear will only be expected to be collected after getting Sun's Song.

shuffle_kokiri_sword.name: Shuffle Kokiri Sword
description:
Shuffles the Kokiri Sword into the item pool.

This will require the use of sticks until the Kokiri Sword is found.

shuffle_master_sword.name: Shuffle Master Sword
description:
Shuffles the Master Sword into the item pool.

Adult Link will start with a second free item instead of the Master Sword.
If you haven't found the Master Sword before facing Ganon, you won't receive it during the fight.

swordless_epona_items.name: Swordless Epona Items
description: Restores the vanilla glitch that lets a swordless player use C-button items (bottles, bombs,
magic, etc.) while riding Epona.
When disabled, the B button is forced to the bow and the C buttons are disabled while swordless
on Epona, blocking the glitch.

shuffle_child_wallet.name: Shuffle Child's Wallet
description:
Enabling this shuffles the Child's Wallet into the item pool.

You will not be able to carry any rupees until you find a wallet.

include_tycoon_wallet.name: Include Tycoon Wallet
include_tycoon_wallet.description: Enabling this adds an extra Progressive Wallet to the pool and adds a new 999 capacity tier after Giant's Wallet.

shuffle_ocarina.name: Shuffle Ocarinas
description:
Enabling this shuffles the Fairy Ocarina and the Ocarina of Time into the item pool.

This will require finding an Ocarina before being able to play songs.

shuffle_ocarina_buttons.name: Shuffle Ocarina Buttons
description:
Enabling this shuffles the Ocarina buttons into the item pool.

This will require finding the buttons before being able to use them in songs.

shuffle_swim.name: Shuffle Swim
description:
Shuffles the ability to Swim into the item pool as a progressive upgrade before Silver Scale.
The ability to swim has to be found as an item (you can still be underwater with iron boots).

If you enter a water entrance without swim you will be respawned on land to prevent infinite death loops.
If you void out in the Water Temple you will immediately be kicked out to prevent a softlock.

shuffle_grab.name: Shuffle Grab
shuffle_grab.description: Shuffle the ability to grab as a progressive upgrade before Goron Bracelet.

shuffle_climb.name: Shuffle Climb
shuffle_climb.description: Shuffle the ability to climb ladders into the item pool.

shuffle_crawl.name: Shuffle Crawl
shuffle_crawl.description: Shuffles the ability to use crawlspaces into the item pool.

shuffle_speak.name: Shuffle Jabber Nuts
description:
Shuffle the ability to speak to NPCs. 6 jabbernuts will be shuffled:
Deku, Gerudo, Goron, Hylian, Kokiri, Zora
Kaepora Gaebora speaks any language.

shuffle_open_chest.name: Shuffle Open Chest
description:
Shuffles the ability to open chests into the item pool.

Progressive shuffles two copies: first only opens small chests, second also opens big chests.

shuffle_weird_egg.name: Shuffle Weird Egg
description:
Vanilla: Malon gives the Weird Egg at Hyrule Castle.

Shuffled: shuffles Weird Egg into item pool.

Skip Waking Talon: Talon is already awake and back at Lon Lon Ranch with Malon.

shuffle_zeldas_letter.name: Shuffle Zelda's Letter
description:
Shuffles Zelda's Letter into the item pool; meeting Zelda gives a random item instead.

Required to open the Kakariko gate and Happy Mask Shop. Starting with the letter starts with the gate 
opened.

Meeting Zelda still triggers Saria at Sacred Forest Meadow.

When disabled, "Start with Zelda's Letter" skips child Zelda: you also get the item Impa would give.

shuffle_scarecrows_song.name: Shuffle Scarecrow's Song
description: Shuffles Scarecrow's Song into the item pool. Teaching Bonooru a song as child, then playing it
back to him as adult, gives a random item instead.

shuffle_gerudo_membership_card.name: Shuffle Gerudo Membership Card
description: Shuffles the Gerudo Membership Card into the item pool.
The Gerudo Card is required to enter the Gerudo Training Ground, opening
the gate to Haunted Wasteland and the Horseback Archery minigame.

shuffle_pots.name: Shuffle Pots
description:
Pots will drop a randomized item the first time they're broken and collected. This does not include the 
flying pots.
 Pots will have a different appearance when they hold a randomized item.
With this option enabled, Ganon's Boss Key door is moved further up the stairs to
allow access to the pots before obtaining Ganon's Boss Key.

Off - Pots will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle pots that are within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle pots that are outside of dungeons.

All pots - Shuffle all pots.

shuffle_crates.name: Shuffle Crates
description:
Crates will drop a randomized item the first time they're broken and collected. 
Crates will have a different appearance when they hold a randomized item.

Off - Crates will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle crates that are within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle crates that are outside of dungeons.

All Crates - Shuffle all crates.

shuffle_trees.name: Shuffle Trees
description: Trees will contain randomized items which are dropped the first time the player rolls into one.
Trees will have a special appearance when carrying randomized items.

Some trees are dependent on Link's age, such as some trees in Hyrule Field.
Two trees at Hyrule Castle are
only shuffled with No Logic.

shuffle_bushes.name: Shuffle Bushes
shuffle_bushes.description: Bushes in Hyrule Field & Zora's Fountain will contain randomized items when first walked through.

shuffle_icicles.name: Shuffle Icicles
description: Stalagmites and stalactites in the Ice Cavern and Ganon's Castle will contain randomized items when broken.
Icicles will have a halo around them when carrying randomized items.

shuffle_red_ice.name: Shuffle Red Ice
description: Red Ice will give randomized items when melted.
Red Ice will have a particle effect inside it when it holds a randomized item

shuffle_fire_gorons.name: Shuffle Fire Temple Gorons
description: The Gorons imprisoned in the Fire Temple will give a randomized item
when talked to after being freed.
Gorons will have a particle effect above them when they hold a randomized item.

shuffle_signs.name: Shuffle Signs
description:
Signs and readable pedestals, plinths, altars, and graves will grant a 
randomized item the first time they are read. 
Signs will have a particle effect when they hold a randomized item.

Off - Signs will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle signs that are within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle signs that are outside of dungeons.

All Signs - Shuffle all signs.

shuffle_wonder_items.name: Shuffle Wonder Items
description:
Wonder items will drop a randomized item the first time they're collected. 
Wonder items will be marked with swirling particles.

Off - Wonder items will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle wonder items that are within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle wonder items that are outside of dungeons.

All Wonder Items - Shuffle all wonder items.

shuffle_fishing_pole.name: Shuffle Fishing Pole
description:
Shuffles the fishing pole into the item pool.

The fishing pole is required to play the fishing pond minigame.

infinite_upgrades.name: Infinite Upgrades
description:
Adds upgrades that hold infinite quantities of items (bombs, arrows, etc.).

Progressive - The infinite upgrades are obtained after getting the last normal capacity upgrade.

Condensed Progressive - The infinite upgrades are obtained as the first capacity upgrade (doesn't apply to 
the infinite wallet or to infinite magic).

shuffle_deku_stick_bag.name: Shuffle Deku Stick Bag
description:
Shuffles the Deku Stick bag into the item pool.

The Deku Stick bag is required to hold Deku Sticks.

shuffle_deku_nut_bag.name: Shuffle Deku Nut Bag
description:
Shuffles the Deku Nut bag into the item pool.

The Deku Nut bag is required to hold Deku Nuts.

shopsanity.name: Shop Shuffle
description:
Off - All shop items will be the same as vanilla.

Specific Count - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops, and 
each shop will contain a specific number (0-7) of non-vanilla shop items.

Random - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops, and 
each shop will contain a random number (1-7) of non-vanilla shop items.

shopsanity_count.name: Shops Item Count
description:
0 Items - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops.

1-7 Items - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops, and 
each shop will contain 1-7 non-vanilla shop items.

8 Items - All shops will contain 8 non-vanilla shop items. 
Only available with No Logic, since logic otherwise requires at least one buyable refill per shop.

shopsanity_prices.name: Shops Prices
description:
Vanilla - The same price as the item it replaced.
Cheap Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 95 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 300 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Fixed - A fixed number.
Range - A random point between specific ranges.
Set By Wallet - Set weights that decide the choice of each wallet, and get a random price in that range if that wallet is chosen.

shopsanity_prices_range_1.name: Shops Lower Bound
shopsanity_prices_range_1.description: The first part of the inclusive range of prices to allow for Shopsanity checks.

shopsanity_prices_range_2.name: Shops Upper Bound
shopsanity_prices_range_2.description: The second part of the inclusive range of prices to allow for Shopsanity checks.

shopsanity_prices_no_wallet_weight.name: Shops No Wallet Weight
shopsanity_prices_no_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Shopsanity checks to be free.

shopsanity_prices_child_wallet_weight.name: Shops Child Wallet Weight
shopsanity_prices_child_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Shopsanity checks to be purchasable with Child's Wallet (1-99).

shopsanity_prices_adult_wallet_weight.name: Shops Adult Wallet Weight
shopsanity_prices_adult_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Shopsanity checks to be purchasable with Adult's Wallet (100-200).

shopsanity_prices_giant_wallet_weight.name: Shops Giant Wallet Weight
shopsanity_prices_giant_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Shopsanity checks to be purchasable with Giant's Wallet (201-500).

shopsanity_prices_tycoon_wallet_weight.name: Shops Tycoon Wallet Weight
shopsanity_prices_tycoon_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Shopsanity checks to be purchasable with Tycoon Wallet (500+).

shopsanity_prices_affordable.name: Shops Affordable Prices
description:
After choosing a price, set it to the affordable amount based on the wallet required.

Affordable prices per tier: starter = 1, adult = 100, giant = 201, tycoon = 501

Use this to enable wallet tier locking, but make shop items not as expensive as they could be.

shop_shields_and_tunics_only_refill.name: Gate Shop Shields & Tunics
description: Non-randomized shields and tunics sold in shops cannot be purchased until you have first found a shield elsewhere.
Regions containing a shield or tunic will not be hinted foolish.

fishsanity.name: Fishsanity
description: Off - Fish will not be shuffled. No changes will be made to fishing behavior.
Shuffle only Hyrule Loach - Allows you to earn an item by catching the Hyrule Loach at the fishing pond and
giving it to the owner.
Shuffle Fishing Pond - The fishing pond's fish will be shuffled. Catching a fish in the fishing pond will
grant a reward.
Shuffle Overworld Fish - Fish in generic grottos and Zora's Domain will be shuffled. Catching a fish in a
bottle will give a reward.
Shuffle Both - Both overworld fish and fish in the fishing pond will be shuffled.

fishsanity_pond_count.name: Pond Fish Count
description: The number of fish to randomize in the fishing pool.
If set to maximum, each fish will have a unique check, including a Hyrule Loach which appears only as child,
and
uncaught fish will be given a visual indicator to distinguish from already-caught fish.
Otherwise, any fish caught in the pond will give a reward, until all rewards have been given.

fishsanity_age_split.name: Pond Age Split
description: Enabling this will split the fishing pond fish by age, making fishing pond fish grant different rewards as
child and adult.
If disabled, then the child pond will be shuffled and shared between both ages.
Note that, as child, there is a second loach available in the pond!

shuffle_scrubs.name: Scrubs Shuffle
description:
Off - Scrubs will not be shuffled. The 3 Scrubs that give one-time items in the 
vanilla game (PoH, Deku Nut capacity, and Deku Stick capacity) will not spawn.

One-Time Only - Only the 3 Scrubs that give one-time items in the 
vanilla game are shuffled.

All - All Scrubs are shuffled.

scrubs_prices.name: Scrubs Prices
description:
Vanilla - The same price as the item it replaced.
Cheap Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 95 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 300 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Fixed - A fixed number.
Range - A random point between specific ranges.
Set By Wallet - Set weights that decide the choice of each wallet, and get a random price in that range if 
that wallet is chosen.

scrubs_prices_range_1.name: Scrubs Lower Bound
scrubs_prices_range_1.description: The first part of the inclusive range of prices to allow for Scrub checks.

scrubs_prices_range_2.name: Scrubs Upper Bound
scrubs_prices_range_2.description: The second part of the inclusive range of prices to allow for Scrub checks.

scrubs_prices_no_wallet_weight.name: Scrubs No Wallet Weight
scrubs_prices_no_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Scrub checks to be free.

scrubs_prices_child_wallet_weight.name: Scrubs Child Wallet Weight
scrubs_prices_child_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Scrub checks to be purchasable with Child's Wallet (1-99).

scrubs_prices_adult_wallet_weight.name: Scrubs Adult Wallet Weight
scrubs_prices_adult_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Scrub checks to be purchasable with Adult's Wallet (100-200).

scrubs_prices_giant_wallet_weight.name: Scrubs Giant Wallet Weight
scrubs_prices_giant_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Scrub checks to be purchasable with Giant's Wallet (201-500).

scrubs_prices_tycoon_wallet_weight.name: Scrubs Tycoon Wallet Weight
scrubs_prices_tycoon_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Scrub checks to be purchasable with Tycoon Wallet (500+).

scrubs_prices_affordable.name: Scrubs Affordable Prices
description:
After choosing a price, set it to the affordable amount based on the wallet required.

Affordable prices per tier: starter = 1, adult = 100, giant = 201, tycoon = 501

Use this to enable wallet tier locking, but make scrub items not as expensive as they could be.

shuffle_beehives.name: Shuffle Beehives
shuffle_beehives.description: Beehives give a randomized item from the pool when broken.

shuffle_cows.name: Shuffle Cows
shuffle_cows.description: Cows give a randomized item from the pool upon performing Epona's Song in front of them.

shuffle_merchants.name: Shuffle Merchants
description: This setting governs if the Bean Salesman, Medigoron, Granny and the Carpet Salesman sell a random item.
Beans Only - Only the Bean Salesman will have a check, and a pack of Magic Beans will be added to the item pool.
All But Beans - Medigoron, Granny and the Carpet Salesman will have checks,
a Giant's Knife and a pack of Bombchus will be added to the item pool, and
one of the bottles will contain a Blue Potion.
All - Apply both effects.
Granny's item will only be offered after you have traded in the Odd Mushroom when Shuffle Adult Trade is on.
Otherwise when off, you will need to have found the Claim Check to buy her item (simulating that the trade
quest is complete).

merchant_prices.name: Merchant Prices
description:
Vanilla - The same price as the Check in vanilla, 60 for the Bean Salesman.
Cheap Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 95 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 300 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Fixed - A fixed number.
Range - A random point between specific ranges.
Set By Wallet - Set weights that decide the choice of each wallet, and get a random price in that range if 
that wallet is chosen.

merchant_prices_range_1.name: Merchant Lower Bound
merchant_prices_range_1.description: The first part of the inclusive range of prices to allow for Merchant checks.

merchant_prices_range_2.name: Merchant Upper Bound
merchant_prices_range_2.description: The second part of the inclusive range of prices to allow for Merchant checks.

merchant_prices_no_wallet_weight.name: Merchant No Wallet Weight
merchant_prices_no_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Merchant checks to be free.

merchant_prices_child_wallet_weight.name: Merchant Child Wallet Weight
merchant_prices_child_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Merchant checks to be purchasable with Child's Wallet (1-99).

merchant_prices_adult_wallet_weight.name: Merchant Adult Wallet Weight
merchant_prices_adult_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Merchant checks to be purchasable with Adult's Wallet (100-200).

merchant_prices_giant_wallet_weight.name: Merchant Giant Wallet Weight
merchant_prices_giant_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Merchant checks to be purchasable with Giant's Wallet (201-500).

merchant_prices_tycoon_wallet_weight.name: Merchant Tycoon Wallet Weight
merchant_prices_tycoon_wallet_weight.description: The chance for Merchant checks to be purchasable with Tycoon Wallet (500+).

merchant_prices_affordable.name: Merchant Affordable Prices
description:
After choosing a price, set it to the affordable amount based on the wallet required.

Affordable prices per tier: starter = 1, adult = 100, giant = 201, tycoon = 501

Use this to enable wallet tier locking, but make merchant items not as expensive as they could be.

shuffle_frog_song_rupees.name: Shuffle Frog Song Rupees
description:
Shuffles 5 Purple Rupees into the item pool, and allows
you to earn items by playing songs at the Frog Choir.

This setting does not affect the item earned from playing
the Song of Storms and the frog song minigame.

shuffle_beggar.name: Shuffle Beggar
description: Shuffle the rewards the Beggar gives for selling bugs, fish, and Blue Fire.
The Beggar will give separate rewards to child and adult.

shuffle_fishermans_hat.name: Shuffle Fisherman's Hat
shuffle_fishermans_hat.description: The Fisherman gives a reward for returning his hat.

shuffle_adult_trade.name: Shuffle Adult Trade
description: Adds all of the adult trade quest items into the pool, each of which
can be traded for a unique reward.
You will be able to choose which of your owned adult trade items is visible
in the inventory by selecting the item with A and using the control stick or
D-pad.
If disabled, only the Claim Check will be found in the pool.

shuffle_chest_minigame.name: Shuffle Chest Minigame
description: Shuffles the contents of the Market Treasure Chest Game, including the item you pay
the host for. Both chests in every room can be opened, and the locked doors are opened
with keys found elsewhere instead of keys won in the game.
Six Chest Game Small Keys are added to the pool, or a single keyring holding all six
if the Chest Minigame Keyring is selected under Keyrings.

early_grannys_shop.name: Early Granny's Potion Shop
description: Makes Granny's Potion Shop available from start, rather than requiring the Claim Check to be found first.
This only applies when Shuffle Adult Trade is disabled. With Shuffle Adult
Trade enabled, Granny still requires trading the Odd Mushroom as usual.

shuffle_100_gs_reward.name: Shuffle 100 GS Reward
description: Shuffle the item the cursed rich man in the House of Skulltula gives when you
have collected all 100 Gold Skulltula Tokens.
You can still talk to him multiple times to get Huge Rupees.

shuffle_freestanding.name: Shuffle Freestanding Items
description:
Freestanding rupees & hearts are shuffled into random items. 
Freestanding heart pieces and small keys are already shuffled by default.

Off - freestanding rupees & hearts will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle freestanding rupees & hearts that are within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle freestanding rupees & hearts that are outside of dungeons.

All Items - Shuffle all freestanding rupees & hearts.

shuffle_silver.name: Shuffle Silver Rupees
description:
Silver rupees will be shuffled.
Items will be added to the pool, which completes the silver rupee puzzles,
while silver rupee locations will be random items.
Off - Silver rupees won't be shuffled.

On - Silver rupees will be individually spread out.

Wallet - Silver rupees are shuffled as wallets, a single check to set the flag for collecting them.

Start With - Silver rupees are still replaced with items, but all silver rupee flags start set.

shuffle_fountain_fairies.name: Shuffle Fairies in Fountains
description: Shuffle fairies in fountain locations.
This includes the sets of fairies found in Ganon's Castle and the Desert Oasis.

shuffle_stone_fairies.name: Shuffle Gossip Stone Fairies
shuffle_stone_fairies.description: Shuffle fairies from gossip stone locations.

shuffle_bean_fairies.name: Shuffle Bean Fairies
shuffle_bean_fairies.description: Shuffle fairies from magic bean locations.

shuffle_song_fairies.name: Shuffle Fairy Spots
description: Shuffle fairy spots. These are spots where a big fairy is revealed by a song.
This excludes gossip stones and magic bean locations.

shuffle_grass.name: Shuffle Grass
description:
Grass will drop a randomized item the first time it's cut and collected. 
Grass will have a different appearance when it holds a randomized item.

Off - Grass will not be shuffled.

Dungeons - Only shuffle grass that is within dungeons.

Overworld - Only shuffle grass that is outside of dungeons.

All Grass - Shuffle all grass.

shuffle_dungeon_rewards.name: Shuffle Dungeon Rewards
description:
Shuffles the location of Spiritual Stones and medallions.
Vanilla - Spiritual Stones and medallions will be given by their respective boss.

End of dungeons - Spiritual Stones and medallions will be given as rewards 
for beating major dungeons. Link will always start with one stone or medallion.

Any dungeon - Spiritual Stones and medallions can be found inside any dungeon.

Overworld - Spiritual Stones and medallions can only be found outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Spiritual Stones and medallions can appear anywhere.

shuffle_mapandcompass.name: Maps/Compasses
description:
Start with - You will start with Maps & Compasses from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Maps & Compasses will appear in their vanilla locations.

Own dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear in their respective dungeon.

Any dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Maps & Compasses can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Maps & Compasses can appear anywhere in the world.

keysanity.name: Small Key Shuffle
description:
Start with - You will start with all Small Keys from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Small Keys will appear in their vanilla locations. 
You start with 3 keys in Spirit Temple MQ because the vanilla key layout is not beatable in logic.

Own dungeon - Small Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon. 
If Fire Temple is not a Master Quest dungeon, the door to the Boss Key chest will be unlocked.

Any dungeon - Small Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Small Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Small Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

keyrings.name: Keyrings
description:
Keyrings will replace all small keys from a particular dungeon with a single keyring that awards all keys for 
its associated dungeon.

Off - No dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Random - A random amount of dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Count - A specified amount of randomly selected dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Selection - Hand select which dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings
(can also be left as random, in which case each one will have a 50% chance of being a keyring).

Selecting keyring for dungeons will have no effect if Small Keys are set to Start With or Vanilla.

The maximum amount of Keyrings that can be selected by Random or Count is 8, plus one if 
Gerudo Fortress Carpenters is set to Normal and Gerudo Fortress Keys is set to anything 
other than Vanilla, plus one if Shuffle Chest Minigame is on.

gerudo_keys.name: Gerudo Fortress Keys
description:
Vanilla - Thieves' Hideout Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.

Any dungeon - Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Thieves' Hideout Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

boss_keysanity.name: Boss Key Shuffle
description:
Start with - You will start with Boss Keys from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Boss Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.

Own dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon.

Any dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Boss Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Boss Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

ganons_boss_key.name: Ganon's Boss Key
description:
Vanilla - Ganon's Boss Key will appear in the vanilla location.

Own dungeon - Ganon's Boss Key can appear anywhere inside Ganon's Castle.

Start with - Places Ganon's Boss Key in your starting inventory.

Any dungeon - Ganon's Boss Key can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Ganon's Boss Key can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Ganon's Boss Key can appear anywhere in the world.

Trigger - These settings put the boss key on a trigger, 
granting the key once the requirements are met:
- Stones: Obtain the specified amount of Spiritual Stones.
- Medallions: Obtain the specified amount of medallions.
- Dungeon rewards: Obtain the specified total sum of Spiritual Stones or medallions.
- Dungeons: Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping into 
the blue warp after the boss.
- Tokens: Obtain the specified amount of Skulltula tokens.

gbk_options.name: GBK Reward Options
description: Standard Rewards - Greg does not change logic, Greg does not help obtain GBK, max
number of rewards on slider does not change.
Greg as Reward - Greg does change logic (can be part of expected path for obtaining
GBK), Greg helps obtain GBK, max number of rewards on slider increases by 1 to
account for Greg.
Greg as Wildcard - Greg does not change logic, Greg helps obtain GBK, max number of
rewards on slider does not change.

ganons_soul_options.name: Ganon's Soul Reward Options
description: Standard Rewards - Greg does not change logic, Greg does not help obtain Ganon's Soul, max
number of rewards on slider does not change.
Greg as Reward - Greg does change logic (can be part of expected path for obtaining
Ganon's Soul), Greg helps obtain Ganon's Soul, max number of rewards on slider increases by 1 to
account for Greg.
Greg as Wildcard - Greg does not change logic, Greg helps obtain Ganon's Soul, max number of
rewards on slider does not change.

wincon.name: Win Condition
description:
Defeat Ganon - Defeat Ganon to complete the game.

Anywhere - Collect the Triforce to complete the game. It can appear anywhere in the world.

Trigger - These settings put the completing the game on a trigger, 
playing the credits when the requirements are met:
- Stones: Obtain the specified amount of Spiritual Stones.
- Medallions: Obtain the specified amount of medallions.
- Dungeon rewards: Obtain the specified total sum of Spiritual Stones or medallions.
- Dungeons: Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping into 
the blue warp after the boss.
- Tokens: Obtain the specified amount of Skulltula tokens.
- Triforce Pieces: Obtain the specified number of Triforce Pieces.

wincon_options.name: Win Condition Options
description: Standard Rewards - Greg does not change logic, Greg does not help obtain Ganon's Soul, max
number of rewards on slider does not change.
Greg as Reward - Greg does change logic (can be part of expected path for obtaining
Ganon's Soul), Greg helps obtain Ganon's Soul, max number of rewards on slider increases by 1 to
account for Greg.
Greg as Wildcard - Greg does not change logic, Greg helps obtain Ganon's Soul, max number of
rewards on slider does not change.

big_poe_count.name: Big Poe Target Count
big_poe_count.description: The Poe collector will give a reward for turning in this many Big Poes.

skip_child_stealth.name: Skip Child Stealth
skip_child_stealth.description: The crawlspace into Hyrule Castle goes straight to Zelda, skipping the guards.

skip_epona_race.name: Skip Epona Race
skip_epona_race.description: Epona can be summoned with Epona's Song without needing to race Ingo.

shuffle_masks.name: Shuffle Masks
shuffle_masks.description: The Happy Mask Shop never opens, masks are shuffled with the rest of the items.

skip_planting_beans.name: Skip Planting Beans
description: Beans will be planted once you find beans.
If bean souls are shuffled, you must still find the soul.

item_pool.name: Item Pool
description:
Sets how many major items appear in the item pool.

Plentiful - Extra major items are added to the pool.

Balanced - Original item pool.

Scarce - Some excess items are removed, including health upgrades.

Minimal - Most excess items are removed.

base_ice_traps.name: Base Ice Traps
description:
Sets if ice traps that exist in vanilla are shuffled into the item pool.
If this is on, 1 Trap will always be added to the pool,
an additional trap will be added if the Gerudo Training Ground
is NOT Master Quest,
and 4 more will be added if Ganon's Castle is NOT Master Quest.

additional_ice_traps.name: Additional Ice Traps
description:
Sets how many more Ice Traps will be added to the item pool,
assuming there is enough space after placing Progression Items.

You do not need to have base ice traps on for this setting to work.

ice_trap_percent.name: Ice Trap Percent
description: If set above 0, each Junk item has that chance of being replaced with an extra Ice Trap.

gossip_stone_hints.name: Gossip Stone Hints
description:
Allows Gossip Stones to provide hints on item locations. Hints mentioning 
"Way of the Hero" indicate a location that holds an item required to beat 
the seed.

No hints - No hints will be given at all.

Need Nothing - Hints are always available from Gossip Stones.

Need Stone of Agony - Hints are only available after obtaining the Stone of Agony.

Need Mask of Truth - Hints are only available whilst wearing the Mask of Truth.

hint_clarity.name: Hint Clarity
description:
Sets the difficulty of hints.

Obscure - Hints are unique for each item, but the writing may be cryptic.
Ex: Kokiri Sword > a butter knife

Ambiguous - Hints are clearly written, but may refer to more than one item.
Ex: Kokiri Sword > a sword

Clear - Hints are clearly written and are unique for each item.
Ex: Kokiri Sword > the Kokiri Sword

hint_distribution.name: Hint Distribution
description:
Sets how many hints will be useful.

Useless - Only junk hints.

Balanced - Recommended hint spread.

Strong - More useful hints.

Very Strong - Many powerful hints.

tot_altar_hint.name: ToT Altar Hint
description: Reading the Temple of Time altar as child will tell you the locations of the Spiritual Stones.
Reading the Temple of Time altar as adult will tell you the locations of the medallions, as well as the
conditions for building the Rainbow Bridge and getting the Boss Key for Ganon's Castle.

ganondorf_hint.name: Ganondorf Hint
description: Talking to Ganondorf in his boss room will tell you the location of the Light Arrows and Master Sword.
If this option is enabled and Ganondorf is reachable without these items, Gossip Stones will never hint the
appropriate items.

sheik_la_hint.name: Sheik Light Arrow Hint
description: Talking to Sheik inside Ganon's Castle will tell you the location of the Light Arrows.
If this option is enabled and Sheik is reachable without Light Arrows, Gossip Stones will never hint the
Light Arrows.

dampes_diary_hint.name: Dampe's Diary Hint
dampes_diary_hint.description: Reading the diary of Dampé the gravekeeper as adult will tell you the location of one of the Hookshots.

greg_hint.name: Greg the Green Rupee Hint
greg_hint.description: Talking to the chest game owner after buying a key will tell you the location of Greg the Green Rupee.

loach_hint.name: Hyrule Loach Hint
loach_hint.description: Talking to the fishing pond owner and asking to talk about something will tell you the reward for the Hyrule Loach.

boss_key_hint.name: Boss Door Hints
boss_key_hint.description: Navi will tell you where the Boss Key can be found when prompted at a boss door.

saria_hint.name: Saria's Hint
saria_hint.description: Talking to Saria either in person or through Saria's Song will tell you the location of a progressive magic meter.

mido_hint.name: Mido's Hint
mido_hint.description: Talking to Mido as child will tell you the location of the Kokiri Sword.

fishing_pole_hint.name: Fishing Pole Hint
fishing_pole_hint.description: Talking to the fishing pond owner without the fishing pole will tell you its location.

oot_hint.name: Ocarina of Time Hint
oot_hint.description: Sheik in the Temple of Time will tell you the item and song on the Ocarina of Time.

frogs_hint.name: Frog Ocarina Game Hint
frogs_hint.description: Standing near the pedestal for the frogs in Zora's River will tell you the reward for the frogs' Ocarina game.

biggoron_hint.name: Biggoron's Hint
biggoron_hint.description: Talking to Biggoron will tell you the item he will give you in exchange for the Claim Check.

big_poes_hint.name: Big Poes Hint
big_poes_hint.description: Talking to the Poe Collector in the Market Guardhouse while adult will tell you what you receive for handing in Big Poes.

chickens_hint.name: Chickens Hint
chickens_hint.description: Talking to Anju as a child will tell you the item she will give you for delivering her cuccos to the pen.

malon_hint.name: Malon Hint
description: Talking to Malon as adult will tell you the item on "Link's cow", the cow you win from beating her time on the Lon Lon Obstacle Course.

hba_hint.name: Horseback Archery Hint
description: Talking to the Horseback Archery Gerudo in Gerudo Fortress, or the nearby sign, will tell you what you win
for scoring 1000 and 1500 points on Horseback Archery.

warp_song_hints.name: Warp Song Hints
warp_song_hints.description: Playing a warp song will tell you where it leads. (If warp song destinations are vanilla, this is always enabled.)

scrub_text_hint.name: Scrub Hint Text
scrub_text_hint.description: Business scrubs will reveal the identity of what they're selling.

merchant_text_hint.name: Merchant Hint Text
merchant_text_hint.description: Merchants will reveal the identity of what they're selling (Shops are not affected by this setting).

kak_10_skulls_hint.name: 10 GS Hint
kak_10_skulls_hint.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 10 tokens will tell you the reward.

kak_20_skulls_hint.name: 20 GS Hint
kak_20_skulls_hint.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 20 tokens will tell you the reward.

kak_30_skulls_hint.name: 30 GS Hint
kak_30_skulls_hint.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 30 tokens will tell you the reward.

kak_40_skulls_hint.name: 40 GS Hint
kak_40_skulls_hint.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 40 tokens will tell you the reward.

kak_50_skulls_hint.name: 50 GS Hint
kak_50_skulls_hint.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 50 tokens will tell you the reward.

kak_100_skulls_hint.name: 100 GS Hint
kak_100_skulls_hint.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 100 tokens will tell you the reward.

mask_shop_hint.name: Mask Shop Hint
mask_shop_hint.description: Reading the mask shop sign will tell you rewards from showing masks at the Deku Theatre.

full_wallets.name: Full Wallets
full_wallets.description: Start with a full wallet. All wallet upgrades come filled with rupees.

bombchu_bag.name: Bombchu Bag
description: None - Bombchus have vanilla behavior, any Bombchu requirement is filled by Bomb Bag + a renewable source of
Bombchus.
Single Bag - Bombchus require their own bag to be found before use. 5 of them are added to the pool
(6 if the Carpet Merchant is shuffled). The first Bombchu Bag you find will be a Bag containing 20 chus,
and subsequent bags will be replaced with Bombchu Ammo refills. Once found, they can be replenished at
shops selling refills, Bombchu Bowling and the carpet merchant. Bombchu Bowling is opened by obtaining
the Bombchu Bag.
Progressive Bags - 3 Bombchu Bags are added to the pool, the first one will unlock Bombchus with a capacity
of 20. The second one will upgrade this capacity to 30, and the final one will upgrade the capacity to the
usual 50.
Bombchu Bowling is opened by obtaining the first Bombchu bag.

links_pocket.name: Link's Pocket
description:
Dungeon Reward - Link will start with a Spiritual Stone or Medallion, and specific options will open up.

Advancement - Link will start with a useful item.

Anything - Link will start with a random item.

Nothing - Link will not start with a bonus item.

links_pocket_reward.name: Link's Pocket Reward Type
description:
Any Reward - Link starts with a random Spiritual Stone or Medallion.

Stone - Link starts with a random Spiritual Stone.

Any Medallion - Link starts with a random Medallion.

Light Medallion - Link starts with the Light Medallion.

enable_bombchu_drops.name: Bombchu Drops
description: Once you obtain a Bombchu Bag, refills will sometimes replace
Bomb drops that would spawn.
If you have Bombchu Bag disabled, you will need a Bomb Bag
and existing Bombchus for Bombchus to drop.

progressive_goron_sword.name: Progressive Goron Sword
description:
Giant's Knife and Biggoron's Sword are shuffled as one progressive item: the first copy is the 
breakable Giant's Knife, the second is Biggoron's Sword.

Starting with Biggoron's Sword still starts you with both.
Medigoron only repairs broken Giant's Knife.

blue_fire_arrows.name: Blue Fire Arrows
description: Ice Arrows act like Blue Fire, making them able to melt red ice.
Item placement logic will respect this option, so it might be required to use this to progress.

skeleton_key.name: Skeleton Key
skeleton_key.description: Adds a new item called the "Skeleton Key"; it unlocks every dungeon door locked by a small key.

sunlight_arrows.name: Sunlight Arrows
description: Light Arrows can be used to light up the sun switches instead of using the Mirror Shield.
Item placement logic will respect this option, so it might be required to use this to progress.

bunny_hood.name: Bunny Hood Effect
description: Wearing the Bunny Hood makes Link run 1.5x faster and jump 1.5x further, like in Majora's Mask.
Item placement logic will respect this option, so it might be required to use this to progress.

masks_as_adult.name: Masks as Adult
description: Masks can be equipped as adult instead of being child only.
Item placement logic will respect this option, so it might be required to use this to progress.

rocs_feather.name: Roc's Feather
description: Adds Roc's Feather to the item pool. Roc's Feather is a custom item granting the player a jump on demand.
The jump can also be used when already in mid-air. Roc's Feather is not considered by logic.

nayrus_love_uses.name: Nayru's Love Uses
description: Limits Nayru's Love to a set number of casts. Each Nayru's Love you find adds one use, and this sets
how many are placed in the item pool. Starting with Nayru's Love counts as one. 0 keeps it unlimited.

slingbow_break_beehives.name: Slingshot/Bow Can Break Beehives
slingbow_break_beehives.description: Allows Slingshot and Bow to break beehives when Beehive Shuffle is turned on.

no_logic.name: No Logic
description: Item placement is completely random without any verification for obtainability. MAY BE IMPOSSIBLE TO BEAT.

all_checks_reachable.name: All Checks Reachable
description: When this option is enabled, the randomizer will guarantee that every item is obtainable and every
check is reachable. When disabled, only required items and checks to beat the game
will be guaranteed reachable. Does not apply to No Logic.

shuffle_bean_souls.name: Shuffle Bean Souls
shuffle_bean_souls.description: Shuffle 10 bean souls which must be found to spawn the corresponding soil/plant.

shuffle_boss_souls.name: Shuffle Boss Souls
shuffle_boss_souls.description: Shuffles 8 boss souls (one for each blue warp dungeon). A boss will not appear until you collect its respective soul.

ice_trap_names.name: Ice Trap Trick Names
description:
Sets how Ice Traps disguise themselves in text.

Identical - There's no tell for an item being an Ice Trap.

Similar - The name will be similar to the item's real name (for example, "Korok Sword" instead of "Kokiri Sword").

Misspelled (Vowel) - The name is misspelled by changing a random vowel with another random vowel.

Misspelled (Duplicate) - The name is misspelled by duplicating a random letter.

Revealed - Ice Traps will not disguise themselves in text.

acute_angle_clip.name: Acute angle clip
acute_angle_clip.description: Enables locations requiring jumpslash clips through walls which meet at an acute angle.

advanced_clips.name: Advanced clips
advanced_clips.description: Enables locations requiring clips through walls and objects requiring precise jumps or other tricks.

blank_a.name: Blank A
blank_a.description: Enables locations requiring blank A button; NOTE: this requires the 'Quick Putaway' restoration.

epg.name: Entrance Point Glitch
epg.description: Enables locations requiring use of the Entrance Point Glitch.

equip_swap.name: Equip Swap
equip_swap.description: Enables locations requiring use of equip swap; NOTE: this may expect the 'Allow cursor to be over any slot' enhancement to be turned off.

equip_swap_expects_dins.name: Equip Swap Requires Din's Fire
equip_swap_expects_dins.description: Enables locations requiring use of equip swap once Din's Fire is found.

hess.name: HESS
hess.description: Enables locations requiring a Hyper Extended Super Slide.

isg.name: ISG
isg.description: Enables locations requiring use of the infinite sword glitch.

visible_collision.name: Ignore Visible Collision
description: Allows ignoring visible barriers and objects that do not actually stop Link from walking, climbing or
hitting things, without clipping.
This notably allows for walking through Kak's gate backwards, climb into the back of Impa's house as
Adult from the coop,
and hitting Rusted Switches or boulders through Blocks, Ice and Walls.
This trick only applies to case where doing the thing is trivial, instances where it only works from
certain angles are not part of this trick,
neither are any form of clips, including clipping Link's hitbox inside boulders with a jumpslash.

hookshot_ladders.name: Hookshot Ladders
description: You can skip climb for hookshottable ladders can be skipped by hookshotting the top of the ladder from
the correct distance and angle.
This is more difficult for some ladders than others, and a few are not possible.
Hookshotting climbable walls in the same way is not a trick, as it is trivial to get an angle that
correctly ledge grabs.

grottos_without_agony.name: Hidden Grottos without Stone of Agony
grottos_without_agony.description: Allows entering hidden grottos without the Stone of Agony.

fewer_tunic_requirements.name: Fewer Tunic Requirements
description:
Normally the only hot area logic expects you to navigate without a Goron Tunic is Death Mountain Crater
and you are not expected to navigate underwater sections without a Zora Tunic.

With this trick you are expected to do any underwater area except Central Pillar,
any hot area except Volvagia and the Block lift room in Fire Temple
and the health needed to logically navigate Crater is decreased.

unintuitive_jumps.name: Unintuitive Jumps
description:
Many ledges can be overcome with particular jumps which are simple to execute without items.
This includes jumping from heights to dive deeper without scales,
though this trick doesn't cover Water Temple's Dragon Room.

rusted_switches.name: Hammer Rusted Switches Through Walls
description: Applies to:
- Hitting Fire Temple Highest Goron Chest's Rusted Switch in the SoT Block without Song of Time.
- Hitting the rusted switch in Water Trial through the Ice.
- Hitting MQ Fire Temple Lizalfos Maze's Rusted Switch in the wall.
- Having Adult hammer the rock in the west side crawlspace of MQ Spirit so child can get through without bombchus.
- MQ Spirit Trial's Rusted Switch between the thrones without hitting the eye target to drop an Iron Knuckle.

fire_rings.name: Fire Ring
description: Fire Rings can be run into while Link is invincible from having taken damage,
letting you interact with some objects inside them such as large chests

damage_boost_simple.name: Simple damage boosts
damage_boost_simple.description: Allows damage boosts in order to reach further locations. Can be combined with "Simple hover boosts" for reaching far distances.

hover_boost_simple.name: Simple hover boosts
hover_boost_simple.description: Allows equipping of hover boots when Link is moving at high speeds to extend distance covered, often after recoil. Can be combined with "Simple damage boosts" for greater uses.

blue_fire_mud_walls.name: Blue Fire Beyond Red Ice
description:
Use Blue Fire to break mud walls, detonate bomb flowers, and break floor to King Dodongo.
Does not apply to MQ Dead Hand bomb flowers.
Using blue fire on bombflower to stop rolling goron also requires "Stop Link the Goron with Din's Fire".
Using blue fire arrows to break floor in King Dodongo's chamber also requires "Dodongo's Cavern Smash the Boss Lobby Floor".

open_underwater_chest.name: Open Underwater Chests
open_underwater_chest.description: Underwater chests can be opened by wearing iron boots and hookshotting the chest.

boulder_collision.name: Flawed Boulder Collision
description: From afar, boulder collision is disabled, allowing projectiles to pass through them.
Additionally, boulders do not have projectile collision from below, allow them to be shot into in some cases.

item_extension.name: Item Extension
description:
Slightly extends the range of projectiles such as Hookshot, Bow or Slingshot. Also allows clipping 
projectile past collision. Used for:
- Retrieving DMT Gold Skulltula beside bomb flower
- Hitting switch through wall in Spirit Temple's big mirror room with Bow, Slingshot, or Hookshot
- Hitting switch through wall in Spirit Trial with Bow or Slingshot
- Hitting switch through gate in Shadow Temple MQ with Bow or Slingshot

big_skulltula_pause_lift.name: Big Skulltula Pause Lift
big_skulltula_pause_lift.description: Pausing while a big skulltula is bobbing upwards slightly lifts it, eventually allowing passage without any items.

ground_jump_hard.name: Hard Ground Jumps
description: Enables ground jumps which require some precision outside of setting up jump,
such as needing extra height with jumpslash or jumping while running with hover boots.

slide_jump.name: Sliding Jumps
slide_jump.description: Running forward while sliding sideways on ice can be used to jump on platforms.

voidout_collection.name: Voidout Collection
description:
Some items can be collected by jumping to them, even if it results in voiding out. Used for:
- OGC Gold Skulltula
- HC wonder items without swim
- ZR wonder items without swim
- ZR Waterfall freestanding rupees without swim
- GV wonder items without swim
- GV Octorok grotto rupees without swim
- Colossus oasis fairies
- Deku Tree freestanding hearts before boss
- Water Temple near boss key chest Gold Skulltula
- Shadow MQ after boat and before boss Gold Skulltulas

bomb_detonation.name: Precise Bomb Detonation
description: This trick enables methods that rely on precisely timing the detonation of bombs,
such as detonating bombs on the surface of the water to destroy underwater rocks
or getting the Gold Skulltula in the first room of forest temple as Child.

kf_adult_gs.name: Adult Kokiri Forest GS with Hover Boots
kf_adult_gs.description: Can be obtained without Hookshot by using the Hover Boots off of one of the roots.

lw_bridge.name: Jump onto the Lost Woods Bridge as Adult with a Jumpslash
lw_bridge.description: With very precise movement and a jumpslash it's possible for Adult to jump onto the bridge without needing Longshot, Hover Boots, or Bean.

lw_mido_backflip.name: Backflip over Mido as Adult
lw_mido_backflip.description: With a specific position and angle, you can backflip over Mido.

lost_wood_navi_dive.name: Lost Woods Navi dive
lost_wood_navi_dive.description: You need Deku Sticks or Kokiri Sword to dive with Navi for entering Zora's River.

lw_gs_bean.name: Lost Woods Adult GS with Hookshot
lw_gs_bean.description: You can collect the token with a precise Hookshot use, as long as you can kill the Skulltula somehow first. It can be killed using Bow, Bombchus or Din's Fire. Using Longshot to both kill the skull and grab the token is in default logic.

hc_storms_gs.name: Hyrule Castle Storms Grotto GS with Just Boomerang
hc_storms_gs.description: With precise throws, the Boomerang alone can kill the Skulltula and collect the token, without first needing to blow up the wall.

hf_big_poe_without_epona.name: Big Poe without Epona
hf_big_poe_without_epona.description: Big Poes have a chance of appearing without Epona, you can shoot them quickly with only bow.

kak_tower_gs.name: Kakariko Tower GS with Jumpslash
kak_tower_gs.description: Climb the tower as high as you can without touching the Gold Skulltula, then let go and jumpslash immediately. By jump-slashing from as low on the ladder as possible to still hit the Skulltula, this trick can be done without taking fall damage.

kak_child_windmill_poh.name: Windmill PoH as Child with Precise Jumpslash
kak_child_windmill_poh.description: Can jump up to the spinning platform from below as child with a precise jumpslash timed with the platforms rotation.

kak_rooftop_gs.name: Kakariko Rooftop GS with Hover Boots
description:
Take the Hover Boots from the entrance to Impa's House over to the rooftop of Skulltula House. 
From there, a precise Hover Boots backwalk with backflip can be used to get onto a hill above the side of the village.
And then from there you can Hover onto Impa's rooftop to kill the Skulltula and backflip into the token.

gy_poh.name: Graveyard Freestanding PoH with Boomerang
gy_poh.description: Using a precise moving setup you can obtain the Piece of Heart by having the Boomerang interact with it along the return path.

gy_child_dampe_race_poh.name: Second Dampe Race as Child
gy_child_dampe_race_poh.description: It is possible to complete the second dampe race as child in under a minute, but it is a strict time limit. This is in default logic with Bunny Hood

gy_shadow_fire_arrows.name: Shadow Temple Entry with Fire Arrows
gy_shadow_fire_arrows.description: It is possible to light all of the torches to open the Shadow Temple entrance with just Fire Arrows, but you must be very quick, precise, and strategic with how you take your shots.

dmt_shieldless_climb.name: Death Mountain Trail Child Climb Without Shield
description: Child can make it past the eruption to reach DMT Summit without a Hylian Shield or Nayru's Love
by backwalking or simply taking damage.

dmt_soil_gs.name: Death Mountain Trail Soil GS without Destroying Boulder
dmt_soil_gs.description: Bugs will go into the soft soil even while the boulder is still blocking the entrance. Then, using a precise moving setup you can kill the Gold Skulltula and obtain the token by having the Boomerang interact with it along the return path.

dmt_bombable.name: Death Mountain Trail Chest with Strength
dmt_bombable.description: Child Link can blow up the wall using a nearby bomb flower. You must backwalk with the flower and then quickly throw it toward the wall. This is not a trick if you have Bunny Hood.

dmt_hovers_lower_gs.name: Death Mountain Trail Lower Red Rock GS with Hover Boots
dmt_hovers_lower_gs.description: After killing the Skulltula, the token can be collected without needing to destroy the rock by backflipping down onto it with the Hover Boots. First use the Hover Boots to stand on a nearby fence, and go for the Skulltula Token from there.

dmt_bean_lower_gs.name: Death Mountain Trail Lower Red Rock GS with Magic Bean
dmt_bean_lower_gs.description: After killing the Skulltula, the token can be collected without needing to destroy the rock by jumping down onto it from the bean plant, midflight, with precise timing and positioning.

dmt_js_lower_gs.name: Death Mountain Trail Lower Red Rock GS with Jumpslash
dmt_js_lower_gs.description: After killing the Skulltula, the token can be collected without needing to destroy the rock by jumpslashing from a precise angle.

dmt_climb_hovers.name: Death Mountain Trail Climb with Hover Boots
dmt_climb_hovers.description: It is possible to use the Hover Boots to bypass needing to destroy the boulders blocking the path to the top of Death Mountain.

dmt_upper_gs.name: Death Mountain Trail Upper Red Rock GS with Backflip
dmt_upper_gs.description: After killing the Skulltula, the token can be collected by backflipping into the rock at the correct angle.

dmt_bolero_biggoron.name: Deliver Eye Drops with Bolero of Fire
description:
Playing a warp song normally causes a trade item to spoil immediately, however, it is possible use Bolero to reach Biggoron and still deliver the Eye Drops before they spoil. If you do not wear the Goron Tunic, the heat timer inside the crater will override the trade item's timer.
When you exit to Death Mountain Trail you will have one second to show the Eye Drops before they expire. You can get extra time to show the Eye Drops if you warp immediately upon receiving them.
If you don't have many hearts, you may have to reset the heat timer by quickly dipping in and out of Darunia's chamber or quickly equipping and unequipping the Goron Tunic.
This trick does not apply if "Randomize Warp Song Destinations" is enabled, or if the settings are such that trade items do not need to be delivered within a time limit.

gc_pot.name: Goron City Spinning Pot PoH with Bombchu
gc_pot.description: A Bombchu can be used to stop the spinning pot, but it can be quite finicky to get it to work.

gc_pot_strength.name: Goron City Spinning Pot PoH with Strength
gc_pot_strength.description: Allows for stopping the Goron City Spinning Pot using a Bomb Flower alone, requiring strength in lieu of inventory explosives.

gc_rolling_strength.name: Rolling Goron (Hot Rodder Goron) as Child with Strength
gc_rolling_strength.description:
Use the Bomb Flower on the stairs or near Medigoron. Timing is tight, especially without backwalking.
This is in default logic with Bunny Hood.

gc_leftmost.name: Goron City Maze Left Chest with Hover Boots
gc_leftmost.description: A precise backwalk starting from on top of the crate and ending with a precisely-timed backflip can reach this chest without needing either the Hammer or Silver Gauntlets.

gc_grotto.name: Goron City Grotto with Hookshot While Taking Damage
gc_grotto.description: It is possible to reach the Goron City Grotto by quickly using the Hookshot while in the midst of taking damage from the lava floor.

gc_link_goron_dins.name: Stop Link the Goron with Din's Fire

dmc_hover_bean_poh.name: Crater's Bean PoH with Hover Boots
dmc_hover_bean_poh.description: Hover from the base of the bridge near Goron City and walk up the very steep slope.

dmc_bolero_jump.name: Death Mountain Crater Jump to Bolero
dmc_bolero_jump.description: As Adult, using a shield to drop a pot while you have the perfect speed and position, the pot can push you that little extra distance you need to jump across the gap in the bridge.

dmc_boulder_js.name: Death Mountain Crater Upper to Lower with Hammer
dmc_boulder_js.description: With the Hammer, you can jumpslash the rock twice in the same jump in order to destroy it before you fall into the lava.

dmc_boulder_skip.name: Death Mountain Crater Upper to Lower Boulder Skip
dmc_boulder_skip.description: As adult, With careful positioning, you can jump to the ledge where the boulder is, then use repeated ledge grabs to shimmy to a climbable ledge. This trick supersedes "Death Mountain Crater Upper to Lower with Hammer".

zr_lower.name: Zora's River Lower Freestanding PoH as Adult with Nothing
zr_lower.description: Adult can reach this PoH and the nearby bush with a precise jump, no Hover Boots or Bunny Hood required.

zr_upper.name: Zora's River Upper Freestanding PoH as Adult with Nothing
zr_upper.description: Adult can reach this PoH with a precise jump, no Hover Boots required.

zr_hovers.name: Zora's Domain Entry with Hover Boots
zr_hovers.description: Can hover behind the waterfall as adult.

zr_cucco.name: Zora's Domain Entry with Cucco
zr_cucco.description: You can fly behind the waterfall with a Cucco as child.

zd_king_zora_skip.name: Skip King Zora as Adult with Nothing
zd_king_zora_skip.description: With a precise jump as adult, it is possible to get on the fence next to King Zora from the front to access Zora's Fountain.

zd_gs.name: Zora's Domain GS with No Additional Items
zd_gs.description: A precise jumpslash can kill the Skulltula and recoil back onto the top of the frozen waterfall. To kill it, the logic normally guarantees one of Hookshot, Bow, or Magic.

zf_great_fairy_without_explosives.name: Zora's Fountain Great Fairy without Explosives
zf_great_fairy_without_explosives.description: It's possible to use silver gauntlets to pick up the silver rock and hammer to break the rock below it, allowing you to ledge grab the edge of the hole and get past the breakable wall (hammer can't break the wall itself).

lh_lab_wall_gs.name: Lake Hylia Lab Wall GS with Jumpslash
lh_lab_wall_gs.description: The jumpslash to actually collect the token is somewhat precise.

lh_lab_diving.name: Lake Hylia Lab Dive without Gold Scale
lh_lab_diving.description: Remove the Iron Boots in the midst of Hookshotting the underwater crate.

lh_water_hookshot.name: Water Temple Entry without Iron Boots using Hookshot
lh_water_hookshot.description: When entering Water Temple using Gold Scale instead of Iron Boots, the Longshot is usually used to be able to hit the switch and open the gate. But, by standing in a particular spot, the switch can be hit with only the reach of the Hookshot.

gv_crate_hovers.name: Gerudo Valley Crate PoH as Adult with Hover Boots
gv_crate_hovers.description: From the far side of Gerudo Valley, a precise Hover Boots movement and jump-slash recoil can allow adult to reach the ledge with the crate PoH without needing Longshot. You will take fall damage.

gv_child_cucco_jump.name: Gerudo Valley Jump Fence with Cucco
gv_child_cucco_jump.description: Using cucco as child, it's possible to jumpslash over the gate.

gv_hookshot_bridge.name: Gerudo Valley Bridge with only Hookshot
gv_hookshot_bridge.description: Using Hookshot Extension and a precise setup, you can cross the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley with only a Hookshot.

gv_child_tent.name: Gerudo Valley Enter Carpenter's Tent as Child
gv_child_tent.description: The loading zone for Carpenter's Tent is accessible to child.

pass_guards_with_nothing.name: Sneak Past Moving Gerudo Guards with No Items
pass_guards_with_nothing.description: The logic normally guarantees Bow or Hookshot to stun them from a distance, but every moving guard can be passed with basic movement and AI manipulation. This trick also enables reading the sign outside GTG without Gerudo card, which is barely possible.

gf_wasteland_gate_sidehop_skip.name: Gerudo's Fortress Gate Skip with Sidehop
description: You can sidehop out of bounds from the tower, then sidehop again on the other side of the gate.
This is easiest and most useful for Child, but Adult can also do this to skip the Gerudo Jabber Nut.

gf_adult_skip_wasteland_gate.name: Gerudo's Fortress Skip Wasteland Gate as Adult
description: As adult a precise jumpslash out of bounds with hoverboots from above the jail can be used to get past the gate.
This can also be used to reach the tower and lower the gate for child without climb.

gf_warrior_with_difficult_weapon.name: Gerudo's Fortress Warriors with Difficult Weapons
gf_warrior_with_difficult_weapon.description: Warriors can be defeated with Slingshot or Bombchus.

gf_ledge_clip_into_gtg.name: Ledge Clip into Training Ground
gf_ledge_clip_into_gtg.description: Adult Link can use a ledge clip to enter Gerudo Training Ground without Gerudo Card.

hw_bunny_crossing.name: Wasteland Crossing with Bunny Hood
hw_bunny_crossing.description: You can beat the quicksand by using the increased speed of the Bunny Hood. Note that jumping to the carpet merchant as child typically requires a fairly precise jumpslash.

hw_crossing.name: Wasteland Crossing without Hover Boots or Longshot
hw_crossing.description: You can beat the quicksand by backwalking across it in a specific way. Note that jumping to the carpet merchant as child typically requires a fairly precise jumpslash.

lens_hw.name: Lensless Wasteland
lens_hw.description: By memorizing the path, you can travel through the Wasteland without using the Lens of Truth to see the Poe. The equivalent trick for going in reverse through the Wasteland is "Reverse Wasteland".

hw_reverse.name: Reverse Wasteland
description:
By memorizing the path, you can travel through the Wasteland in reverse. Note that jumping to the carpet merchant as child typically requires a fairly precise jumpslash.
The equivalent trick for going forward through the Wasteland is "Lensless Wasteland".
To cross the river of sand with no additional items, be sure to also enable "Wasteland Crossing without Hover Boots or Longshot".
Unless all overworld entrances are randomized, Child Link will not be expected to do anything at Gerudo's Fortress.

colossus_gs.name: Colossus Hill GS with Hookshot
colossus_gs.description: Somewhat precise. If you kill enough Leevers you can get enough of a break to take some time to aim more carefully.

deku_basement_gs.name: Deku Tree Basement Vines GS with Jumpslash
deku_basement_gs.description: Can be defeated by doing a precise jumpslash.

deku_b1_skip.name: Deku Tree Basement without Slingshot
deku_b1_skip.description: A precise jump can be used to skip needing to use the Slingshot to go around B1 of the Deku Tree. If used with the "Closed Forest" setting, a Slingshot will not be guaranteed to exist somewhere inside the Forest. This trick applies to both Vanilla and Master Quest.

deku_b1_bow_webs.name: Deku Tree Basement Web to Gohma with Bow
description: All spider web walls in the Deku Tree basement can be burnt as adult with just a bow by shooting through torches.
This trick only applies to the circular web leading to Gohma; the two vertical webs are always in logic. Backflip onto the chest near the torch at the bottom of the vine wall.
With precise positioning you can shoot through the torch to the right edge of the circular web. This allows completion of adult Deku Tree with no fire source.

deku_b1_backflip_over_spiked_log.name: Deku Tree Basement Backflip over Spiked Log
deku_b1_backflip_over_spiked_log.description: Allows backflipping over the spiked log in the Deku Tree basement in Vanilla. Only relevant if "Shuffle Swim" is enabled.

deku_mq_compass_gs.name: Deku Tree MQ Compass Room GS Boulders with Just Hammer
deku_mq_compass_gs.description: Climb to the top of the vines, then let go and jumpslash immediately to destroy the boulders using the Hammer, without needing to spawn a Song of Time block.

deku_mq_log.name: Deku Tree MQ Roll Under the Spiked Log
deku_mq_log.description: You can get past the spiked log by rolling to briefly shrink your hitbox. As adult, the timing is a bit more precise.

dc_alcove_gs.name: Dodongo's Cavern Alcove GS from Below with Longshot
dc_alcove_gs.description: The floor blocking Skulltula from below are one-sided collision. You can use the Longshot to get it from below with a precise angle, bypassing the need to lower the staircase.

dc_scarecrow_gs.name: Dodongo's Cavern Scarecrow GS with Armos Statue
dc_scarecrow_gs.description: You can jump off an Armos Statue to reach the alcove with the Gold Skulltula. It takes quite a long time to pull the statue the entire way. The jump to the alcove can be a bit picky when done as child.

dc_vines_gs.name: Dodongo's Cavern Vines GS from Below with Longshot
dc_vines_gs.description: The vines upon which this Skulltula rests are one-sided collision. You can use the Longshot to get it from below, by shooting it through the vines, bypassing the need to lower the staircase.

dc_stairs_with_bow.name: Dodongo's Cavern Stairs with Bow
dc_stairs_with_bow.description: The Bow can be used to knock down the stairs with two well-timed shots.

dc_slingshot_skip.name: Dodongo's Cavern Child Slingshot Skips
dc_slingshot_skip.description: With precise platforming, child can cross the platforms while the flame circles are there. When enabling this trick, it's recommended that you also enable Unintuitive Jumps, which enables Adult to skip this loop in an easier way.

dc_scrub_room.name: Dodongo's Cavern Two Scrub Room with Strength
dc_scrub_room.description: With help from a conveniently-positioned block, Adult (or Child with Bunny Hood) can quickly carry a Bomb Flower over to destroy the mud wall blocking the room with two Deku Scrubs.

dc_jump.name: Dodongo's Cavern Spike Trap Room Jump without Hover Boots
dc_jump.description: The jump is Adult Link only. Applies to both Vanilla and MQ.

dc_hammer_floor.name: Dodongo's Cavern Smash the Boss Lobby Floor
dc_hammer_floor.description: The bombable floor before King Dodongo can be destroyed with Hammer if hit in the very center. This is only relevant with Shuffle Boss Entrances or if Dodongo's Cavern is MQ and either variant of "Dodongo's Cavern MQ Light the Eyes with Strength" is on.

dc_dodongo_chu.name: Dodongo's Cavern Dodongo with Only Bombchus
dc_dodongo_chu.description: With precise timing you can feed King Dodongo a bombchu during a backflip

dc_eyes_bunnyhovers.name: Dodongo's Cavern Dodongo with Goron Bracelet and Bunnyhovers
dc_eyes_bunnyhovers.description: With precisely timed movement using both Bunny Hood and Hover Boots you can use the high-rising platform to carry a Bomb Flower to the Dodongo's Head and quickly throw it close enough to the eyes to trigger them. This requires "Bunny Hood in Logic" to function.

dc_mq_stairs_with_only_strength.name: Dodongo's Cavern MQ Stairs With Only Strength
dc_mq_stairs_with_only_strength.description: Taking a bomb from the back can be used to lower stairs without using stick to drop bomb from wall.

dc_child_lobby.name: Dodongo's Cavern Lobby Recoil to Ledge as Child
dc_child_lobby.description: With a precise jumpslash from above, you can reach the ledge in DC Lobby as Child from the upper area near the tablet. You will take fall damage.

dc_mq_child_eyes.name: Dodongo's Cavern MQ Light the Eyes with Strength as Child
description:
If you move very quickly, it is possible to use the bomb flower at the top of the room to light the eyes.
To perform this trick as child is significantly more difficult than adult.
The player is also expected to complete the DC back area without explosives, including getting past the Armos wall to the switch for the boss door.
