dc_mq_adult_eyes.name: Dodongo's Cavern MQ Light the Eyes with Strength as Adult
dc_mq_adult_eyes.description: If you move very quickly, it is possible to use the bomb flower at the top of the room to light the eyes.

dc_eyes_chu.name: Dodongo's Cavern Light the Eyes with Bombchus
dc_eyes_chu.description: You can light the dodongo head's eyes with bombchus from the main room, allowing instant access to the end of the dungeon.

jabu_alcove_jump_dive.name: Jabu Underwater Alcove as Adult with Jump Dive
jabu_alcove_jump_dive.description: Standing above the underwater tunnel leading to the scrub, jump down and swim through the tunnel. This allows adult to access the alcove with no Scale or Iron Boots. In Vanilla Jabu, this alcove has a business scrub. In MQ Jabu, it has the compass chest and a door switch for the main floor.

jabu_boss_hover.name: Jabu Near Boss Room with Hover Boots
jabu_boss_hover.description: A box for the blue switch can be carried over by backwalking with one while the elevator is at its peak. Alternatively, you can skip transporting a box by quickly rolling from the switch and opening the door before it closes. However, the timing for this is very tight.

jabu_near_boss_ranged.name: Jabu Near Boss Ceiling Switch/GS without Boomerang or Explosives
description: Vanilla Jabu: From near the entrance into the room, you can hit the switch that opens the door to the boss room using a precisely-aimed use of the Slingshot, Bow, or Longshot.
As well, if you climb to the top of the vines you can stand on the right edge of the platform and shoot around the glass. From this distance, even the Hookshot can reach the switch.
This trick is only relevant if "Shuffle Boss Entrances" is enabled.
MQ Jabu: A Gold Skulltula Token can be collected with Longshot using the same methods as hitting the switch in Vanilla.

jabu_near_boss_explosives.name: Jabu Near Boss Ceiling Switch with Explosives
jabu_near_boss_explosives.description: You can hit the switch that opens the door to the boss room using a precisely-aimed Bombchu. Also, using the Hover Boots, adult can throw a Bomb at the switch. This trick is only relevant if "Shuffle Boss Entrances" is enabled.

jabu_b1_cube_hover.name: Jabu B1 Pass Cube with Hover Boots
jabu_b1_cube_hover.description: It's possible reach pots past cube with only hover boots.

lens_jabu_mq.name: Jabu MQ without Lens of Truth
lens_jabu_mq.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Jabu MQ.

jabu_mq_rang_jump.name: Jabu MQ Compass Chest with Boomerang
jabu_mq_rang_jump.description: Boomerang can reach the cow switch to spawn the chest by targeting the cow, jumping off of the ledge where the chest spawns, and throwing the Boomerang in midair.

jabu_mq_sot_gs.name: Jabu MQ Song of Time Block GS with Boomerang
jabu_mq_sot_gs.description: Allow the Boomerang to return to you through the Song of Time block to grab the token.

jabu_barinade_pots.name: Jabu Barinade with Pots
jabu_barinade_pots.description: Barinade can be damaged with pots, requiring only boomerang to defeat.

lens_botw.name: Bottom of the Well without Lens of Truth
lens_botw.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Bottom of the Well.

bottom_of_the_well_navi_dive.name: Bottom of the Well Navi dive
bottom_of_the_well_navi_dive.description: You need Deku Sticks or Kokiri Sword to dive with Navi for entering Bottom of the Well.

botw_child_deadhand.name: Child Dead Hand without Kokiri Sword

botw_basement.name: Bottom of the Well Map Chest with Strength & Sticks
botw_basement.description: The chest in the basement can be reached with strength by doing a jumpslash with a lit stick to access the Bomb Flowers.

botw_pits.name: Bottom of the Well MQ Jump Over the Pits
botw_pits.description: While the pits in Bottom of the Well don't allow you to jump just by running straight at them, you can still get over them by side-hopping or backflipping across. With explosives, this allows you to access the central areas without Zelda's Lullaby. With Zelda's Lullaby, it allows you to access the west inner room without explosives.

botw_mq_deadhand_key.name: Bottom of the Well MQ Dead Hand Freestanding Key with Boomerang
botw_mq_deadhand_key.description: Boomerang can fish the item out of the rubble without needing explosives to blow it up.

forest_first_gs.name: Forest Temple First Room GS with Melee Weapons
forest_first_gs.description: Allows killing this Skulltula with Sword or Sticks by jumpslashing it as you let go from the vines.

forest_courtyard_east_gs.name: Forest Temple East Courtyard GS with Boomerang
forest_courtyard_east_gs.description: Precise Boomerang throws can allow child to kill the Skulltula and collect the token.

forest_vines.name: Forest Temple East Courtyard Vines with Hookshot
forest_vines.description: The vines in Forest Temple leading to where the well drain switch is in the standard form can be barely reached with just the Hookshot. Applies to MQ also.

forest_courtyard_ledge.name: Forest Temple NE Courtyard Ledge with Hover Boots
forest_courtyard_ledge.description: With precise Hover Boots movement you can fall down to this ledge from upper balconies. If done precisely enough, it is not necessary to take fall damage. In MQ, this skips a Longshot requirement. In Vanilla, this can skip a Hookshot requirement in entrance randomizer.

forest_doorframe.name: Forest Temple East Courtyard Door Frame with Hover Boots
description:
A precise Hover Boots movement from the upper balconies in this courtyard can be used to get on top of the door frame. Applies to both Vanilla and Master Quest.
In Vanilla, from on top the door frame you can summon Pierre, allowing you to access the falling ceiling room early.
In Master Quest, this allows you to obtain the GS on the door frame as adult without Hookshot or Song of Time.

forest_outside_backdoor.name: Forest Temple Outside Backdoor with Jumpslash
forest_outside_backdoor.description: A jumpslash recoil can be used to reach the ledge in the block puzzle room that leads to the west courtyard. This skips a potential Hover Boots requirement in Vanilla, and it can sometimes apply in MQ as well. This trick can be performed as both ages.

forest_courtyard_hearts_boomerang.name: Forest Temple Courtyard Hearts with Boomerang
forest_courtyard_hearts_boomerang.description: A well aimed boomerang from the water's edge can reach the hearts from ground level. If unable to swim, you can back away from the water while the boomerang is returning so the hearts land on the ground.

forest_well_swim.name: Swim Through Forest Temple Well with Hookshot
forest_well_swim.description: Shoot the vines in the well as low and as far to the right as possible, and then immediately swim under the ceiling to the right. This is usually only useful in Master Quest.

forest_mq_block_puzzle.name: Skip Forest Temple MQ Block Puzzle with Bombchu
forest_mq_block_puzzle.description: Send the Bombchu straight up the center of the wall directly to the left upon entering the room.

forest_mq_js_hallway_switch.name: Forest Temple MQ Twisted Hallway Switch with Jumpslash
forest_mq_js_hallway_switch.description: The switch to twist the hallway can be hit with a jumpslash through the glass block. To get in front of the switch, either use the Hover Boots or hit the shortcut switch at the top of the room and jump from the glass blocks that spawn. Sticks can be used as child, but the Kokiri Sword is too short to reach through the glass.

forest_mq_hookshot_hallway_switch.name: Forest Temple MQ Twisted Hallway Switch with Hookshot
forest_mq_hookshot_hallway_switch.description: There's a very small gap between the glass block and the wall. Through that gap you can hookshot the target on the ceiling.

forest_mq_rang_hallway_switch.name: Forest Temple MQ Twisted Hallway Switch with Boomerang
forest_mq_rang_hallway_switch.description: The Boomerang can return to Link through walls, allowing child to hit the hallway switch. This can be used to allow adult to pass through later, or in conjunction with "Forest Temple Outside Backdoor with Jumpslash".

forest_mq_child_doorframe.name: Forest Temple MQ Doorframe GS as Child without Boomerang
description: If Adult burns the courtyard webbing with Fire Arrows (which is a permanent flag in Ship Rando)
then Child can climb up to the balconies and jump to the SoT block from the railing,
and from there either roll jump or jump against the wall to reach the doorframe.
From there, The GS can be killed with a crouchstab, explosives or other ranged weapon and collected by climbing down.

fire_sot.name: Fire Temple Song of Time Room GS without Song of Time
fire_sot.description: A precise jump can be used to reach this room.

fire_strength.name: Fire Temple Climb without Strength
fire_strength.description: A precise jump can be used to skip pushing the block.

fire_scarecrow.name: Fire Temple East Tower without Scarecrow's Song
fire_scarecrow.description: Also known as "Pixelshot". The Longshot can reach the target on the elevator itself, allowing you to skip needing to spawn the scarecrow.

fire_skip_flame_walls.name: Fire Temple Skip Flame Walls
description: If you move quickly you can sneak past the edge of a flame wall before rises up to block you. To
do it without taking damage is more precise. Allows progress without needing either a Small Key or
Hover Boots. In MQ if either "Fire Temple MQ Lower to Upper Lizalfos Maze with Hover Boots" or
"with Precise Jump" are enabled, this also allows progress deeper into the dungeon without Hookshot.
Child can sidehop past fire wall in MQ lobby.

fire_mq_near_boss.name: Fire Temple MQ Chest Near Boss without Breaking Crate
fire_mq_near_boss.description: The hitbox for the torch extends a bit outside of the crate. Shoot a flaming arrow at the side of the crate to light the torch without needing to get over there and break the crate.

fire_mq_blocked_chest.name: Fire Temple MQ Big Lava Room Blocked Door without Hookshot
fire_mq_blocked_chest.description: There is a gap between the hitboxes of the flame wall in the big lava room. If you know where this gap is located, you can jump through it and skip needing to use the Hookshot. To do this without taking damage is more precise.

fire_mq_bk_chest.name: Fire Temple MQ Boss Key Chest without Bow
fire_mq_bk_chest.description: It is possible to light both of the timed torches to unbar the door to the boss key chest's room with just Din's Fire if you move very quickly between the two torches. It is also possible to unbar the door with just Din's Fire by abusing an oversight in the way the game counts how many torches have been lit.

fire_mq_climb.name: Fire Temple MQ Climb without Fire Source
fire_mq_climb.description: You can use the Hover Boots to hover around to the climbable wall, skipping the need to use a fire source and spawn a Hookshot target.

fire_mq_maze_side_room.name: Fire Temple MQ Lizalfos Maze Side Room without Box
fire_mq_maze_side_room.description: You can walk from the blue switch to the door and quickly open the door before the bars reclose. This skips needing to reach the upper sections of the maze to get a box to place on the switch.

fire_mq_maze_hovers.name: Fire Temple MQ Lower to Upper Lizalfos Maze with Hover Boots
fire_mq_maze_hovers.description: Use the Hover Boots off of a crate to climb to the upper maze without needing to spawn and use the Hookshot targets.

fire_mq_maze_jump.name: Fire Temple MQ Lower to Upper Lizalfos Maze with Precise Jump
fire_mq_maze_jump.description: A precise jump off of a crate can be used to climb to the upper maze without needing to spawn and use the Hookshot targets. This trick supersedes both "Fire Temple MQ Lower to Upper Lizalfos Maze with Hover Boots" and "Fire Temple MQ Lizalfos Maze Side Room without Box".

fire_mq_above_maze_gs.name: Fire Temple MQ Above Flame Wall Maze GS from Below with Longshot
fire_mq_above_maze_gs.description: The floor of the room that contains this Skulltula is only solid from above. From the maze below, the Longshot can be shot through the ceiling to obtain the token with two fewer small keys than normal.

water_high_emblem_jump.name: Water Temple Jump to High Emblem with Nothing
water_high_emblem_jump.description: Adult can jump directly to the Emblem that sets the water level to high from the pillar with nothing by aiming for the middle of the ledge. Child with the help of Bunny Hood can do the same, but even easier.

water_longshot_torch.name: Water Temple Torch Longshot
description: Stand on the eastern side of the central pillar and longshot the torches on the bottom level. Swim through the corridor and float up to the top level. This allows access to this area and lower water levels without Iron Boots.
The majority of the tricks that allow you to skip Iron Boots in the Water Temple are not going to be relevant unless this trick is first enabled.

water_cracked_wall_hovers.name: Water Temple Cracked Wall with Hover Boots
water_cracked_wall_hovers.description: With a midair side-hop while wearing the Hover Boots, you can reach the cracked wall without needing to raise the water up to the middle level.

water_cracked_wall.name: Water Temple Cracked Wall with No Additional Items
water_cracked_wall.description: A precise jumpslash (among other methods) will get you to the cracked wall without needing the Hover Boots or to raise the water to the middle level. This trick supersedes "Water Temple Cracked Wall with Hover Boots".

water_bk_region.name: Water Temple Boss Key Region with Hover Boots
water_bk_region.description: With precise Hover Boots movement it is possible to reach the boss key chest's region without needing the Longshot. It is not necessary to take damage from the spikes. The Gold Skulltula Token in the following room can also be obtained with just the Hover Boots.

water_north_basement_ledge_jump.name: Water Temple North Basement Ledge with Precise Jump
water_north_basement_ledge_jump.description: In the northern basement there's a ledge from where, in Vanilla Water Temple, boulders roll out into the room. Normally to jump directly to this ledge logically requires the Hover Boots, but with precise jump, it can be done without them. This trick applies to both Vanilla and Master Quest.

water_fw_central_gs.name: Water Temple Central Pillar GS with Farore's Wind
water_fw_central_gs.description: If you set Farore's Wind inside the central pillar and then return to that warp point after raising the water to the highest level, you can obtain this Skulltula Token with Hookshot or Boomerang.

water_irons_central_gs.name: Water Temple Central Pillar GS with Iron Boots
water_irons_central_gs.description: After opening the middle water level door into the central pillar, the door will stay unbarred so long as you do not leave the room, even if you were to raise the water up to the highest level. With the Iron Boots to go through the door after the water has been raised, you can obtain the Skulltula Token with the Hookshot.

water_central_bow.name: Water Temple Central Bow Target without Longshot or Hover Boots
water_central_bow.description: A very precise Bow shot can hit the eye switch from the floor above. Then, you can jump down into the hallway and make through it before the gate closes. It can also be done as child, using the Slingshot instead of the Bow.

water_hookshot_falling_platform_gs.name: Water Temple Falling Platform Room GS with Hookshot
water_hookshot_falling_platform_gs.description: If you stand on the very edge of the platform, this Gold Skulltula can be obtained with only the Hookshot.

water_rang_falling_platform_gs.name: Water Temple Falling Platform Room GS with Boomerang
water_rang_falling_platform_gs.description: If you stand on the very edge of the platform, this Gold Skulltula can be obtained with only the Boomerang.

water_river_gs.name: Water Temple River GS without Iron Boots
water_river_gs.description: Standing on the exposed ground toward the end of the river, a precise Longshot use can obtain the token. The Longshot cannot normally reach far enough to kill the Skulltula, however. You'll first have to find some other way of killing it.

water_dragon_jump_dive.name: Water Temple Dragon Statue Jump Dive
water_dragon_jump_dive.description: If you come into the dragon statue room from the serpent river, you can sidehop down from above and get into the tunnel without needing either Iron Boots or a Scale. Alternatively, you can do this while equipping irons in midair to get into the tunnel without swim. This trick applies to both Vanilla and Master Quest. In Vanilla, you must shoot the switch from above with the Bow, and then quickly get through the tunnel before the gate closes.

water_adult_dragon.name: Water Temple Dragon Statue Switch from Above the Water as Adult
description: Normally you need both Hookshot and Iron Boots to hit the switch and swim through the tunnel to get to the chest. But by hitting the switch from dry land, using one of Bombchus, Hookshot, or Bow, it is possible to skip one or both of those requirements.

After the gate has been opened, besides just using the Iron Boots, a well-timed dive with at least the Silver Scale could be used to swim through the tunnel. If coming from the serpent river, a jump dive can also be used to get into the tunnel.

water_child_dragon.name: Water Temple Dragon Statue Switch from Above the Water as Child
description: It is possible for child to hit the switch from dry land using one of Bombchus, Slingshot or Boomerang. Then, to get to the chest, child can dive through the tunnel using at least the Silver Scale.
The timing and positioning of this dive needs to be perfect to actually make it under the gate, and it all needs to be done very quickly to be able to get through before the gate closes.
Be sure to enable "Water Temple Dragon Statue Switch from Above the Water as Adult" for adult's variant of this trick.

water_mq_central_pillar.name: Water Temple MQ Central Pillar with Fire Arrows
description: Slanted torches have misleading hitboxes. Whenever you see a slanted torch jutting out of the wall, you can expect most or all of its hitbox is actually on the other side that wall.
This can make slanted torches very finicky to light when using arrows.
The torches in the central pillar of MQ Water Temple are a particularly egregious example. Logic normally expects Din's Fire and Song of Time.

water_iron_boots_ledge_grab.name: Water Temple Ledge Grab While Surfacing with Iron Boots
description: Diving in front of ledge tapping B to swim up faster, then equipping iron boots while surfacing allows you to
ledge grab to the higher ground. This can be used to reach ledge to boss door and vanilla compass chest, or
MQ storage room

water_invisible_hookshot_target.name: Water Temple Invisible Hookshot Target
description: Invisible hookshot geometry can be used in MQ to get over the gate that blocks you from going to this
Skulltula early, skipping a small key as well as needing Hovers or Scarecrow to reach the locked door.
In vanilla this can be used to leave the water and pass in either direction without Bronze Scale using Iron Boots and Hookshot.

water_morpha_without_hookshot.name: Water Temple Morpha without Hookshot
water_morpha_without_hookshot.description: It is possible to slash at Morpha without hookshot.

lens_shadow.name: Shadow Temple Stationary Objects without Lens of Truth
lens_shadow.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Shadow Temple for most areas in the dungeon except for crossing the moving platform in the huge pit room and for fighting Bongo Bongo.

lens_shadow_platform.name: Shadow Temple Invisible Moving Platform without Lens of Truth
lens_shadow_platform.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Shadow Temple to cross the invisible moving platform in the huge pit room in either direction.

lens_bongo.name: Shadow Temple Bongo Bongo without Lens of Truth
lens_bongo.description: Bongo Bongo can be defeated without the use of Lens of Truth, as the hands give a pretty good idea of where the eye is.

shadow_umbrella_hover.name: Shadow Temple Stone Umbrella Skip
shadow_umbrella_hover.description: A very precise Hover Boots movement from off of the lower chest can get you on top of the falling spikes without needing to pull the block. Applies to both Vanilla and Master Quest.

shadow_umbrella_clip.name: Shadow Temple Stone Umbrella Clip
shadow_umbrella_clip.description: Backflipping as the falling spikes fall clips above without needing any other requirements. Applies to both Vanilla and Master Quest.

shadow_umbrella_gs.name: Shadow Temple Falling Spikes GS with Hover Boots
shadow_umbrella_gs.description: After killing the Skulltula, a very precise Hover Boots movement from off of the lower chest can get you on top of the falling spikes without needing to pull the block. From there, another very precise Hover Boots movement can be used to obtain the token without needing the Hookshot. Applies to both Vanilla and Master Quest.

shadow_freestanding_key.name: Shadow Temple Freestanding Key with Bombchu
shadow_freestanding_key.description: Release the Bombchu with good timing so that it explodes near the bottom of the pot.

shadow_statue.name: Shadow Temple River Statue with Bombchu
shadow_statue.description: By sending a Bombchu around the edge of the gorge, you can knock down the statue without needing a Bow. Applies in both Vanilla and MQ Shadow.

shadow_bunny_statue.name: Shadow Temple climb onto the statue as Child with Bunny Hood and Jumpslash
shadow_bunny_statue.description: Child cannot normally jump onto the broken statue from the boss room side of the chasm, however by combining a Bunny Hood jump and a frame perfect Jumpslash they can barely make it on top.

shadow_bongo.name: Shadow Temple Bongo Bongo without projectiles
shadow_bongo.description: Using precise sword slashes, Bongo Bongo can be defeated without using projectiles. This is only relevant in conjunction with Shadow Temple dungeon shortcuts or shuffled boss entrances.

lens_shadow_mq.name: Shadow Temple MQ Stationary Objects without Lens of Truth
description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Shadow Temple MQ for most areas in the dungeon.

See "Shadow Temple MQ Invisible Moving Platform without Lens of Truth", "Shadow Temple MQ Invisible Blades Silver Rupees without Lens of Truth", "Shadow Temple MQ 2nd Dead Hand without Lens of Truth", and "Shadow Temple Bongo Bongo without Lens of Truth" for exceptions.

lens_shadow_mq_invisible_blades.name: Shadow Temple MQ Invisible Blades Silver Rupees without Lens of Truth
lens_shadow_mq_invisible_blades.description: Removes the requirement for the Lens of Truth or Nayru's Love in Shadow Temple MQ for the Invisible Blades room Silver Rupee collection.

lens_shadow_mq_platform.name: Shadow Temple MQ Invisible Moving Platform without Lens of Truth
lens_shadow_mq_platform.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Shadow Temple MQ to cross the invisible moving platform in the huge pit room in either direction.

lens_shadow_mq_deadhand.name: Shadow Temple MQ 2nd Dead Hand without Lens of Truth
lens_shadow_mq_deadhand.description: Dead Hand spawns in a random spot within the room. Having Lens removes the hassle of having to comb the room looking for his spawn location.

shadow_mq_gap.name: Shadow Temple MQ Truth Spinner Gap with Longshot
shadow_mq_gap.description: You can Longshot a torch and jump-slash recoil onto the tongue. It works best if you Longshot the right torch from the left side of the room.

shadow_mq_invisible_blades.name: Shadow Temple MQ Invisible Blades without Song of Time
shadow_mq_invisible_blades.description: The Like Like can be used to boost you into the Silver Rupee or Recovery Hearts that normally require Song of Time. This cannot be performed on OHKO since the Like Like does not boost you high enough if you die.

shadow_mq_huge_pit.name: Shadow Temple MQ Lower Huge Pit without Fire Source
shadow_mq_huge_pit.description: Normally a frozen eye switch spawns some platforms that you can use to climb down, but there's actually a small piece of ground that you can stand on that you can just jump down to. Bunny hood and Hover Boots together can solve this without the trick.

shadow_mq_windy_walkway.name: Shadow Temple MQ Windy Walkway Reverse without Hover Boots
shadow_mq_windy_walkway.description: It is possible to jump from the alcove in the windy hallway to the middle platform. There are two methods: wait out the fan opposite the door and hold forward, or jump to the right to be pushed by the fan there towards the platform ledge. Note that jumps of this distance are inconsistent, but still possible.

lens_spirit.name: Spirit Temple without Lens of Truth
lens_spirit.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Spirit Temple.

spirit_child_chu.name: Spirit Temple Child Side Bridge with Bombchu
spirit_child_chu.description: A carefully-timed Bombchu can hit the switch.

spirit_west_ledge.name: Spirit Temple Statue Room West Ledge Checks with Boomerang
description: By carefully walking onto the upper arm of the statue, it's possible to get a good angle on the
Gold Skulltula (In Vanilla) and the farthest pot (In MQ) to collect the checks with Boomerang.
The nearest pot in MQ can be reached from the forearm and is always in logic.

spirit_lower_adult_switch.name: Spirit Temple Lower Adult Switch with Bombs
spirit_lower_adult_switch.description: A bomb can be used to hit the switch on the ceiling, but it must be thrown from a particular distance away and with precise timing.

spirit_statue_jump.name: Spirit Temple Statue Room Jump from Hands to Upper Ledges
spirit_statue_jump.description: A precise jump to obtain the following as Adult without needing one of Hover Boots, or Hookshot (in Vanilla) or Song of Time (in MQ). Using Bunny Hood puts this trick in default logic.: - Spirit Temple Statue Room Northeast Chest - Spirit Temple GS Lobby - Spirit Temple MQ Central Chamber Top Left Pot (Left) - Spirit Temple MQ Central Chamber Top Left Pot (Right)

spirit_platform_hookshot.name: Spirit Temple Main Room Hookshot to Boss Platform
spirit_platform_hookshot.description: Precise hookshot aiming at the platform chains can be used to reach the boss platform from the middle landings. Using a jumpslash immediately after reaching a chain makes aiming more lenient. Relevant only when Spirit Temple boss shortcuts are on.

spirit_map_chest.name: Spirit Temple Map Chest with Bow
spirit_map_chest.description: To get a line of sight from the upper torch to the map chest torches, you must pull an Armos statue all the way up the stairs.

spirit_sun_chest.name: Spirit Temple Sun Block Room Chest with Bow
description: Using the blocks in the room as platforms you can get lines of sight to all three torches.
The timer on the torches is quite short so you must move quickly in order to light all three.
A backflip can be used instead to light torches without pushing blocks.

spirit_wall.name: Spirit Temple Shifting Wall with No Additional Items
spirit_wall.description: Logic normally guarantees a way of dealing with both the Beamos and the Walltula before climbing the wall.

lens_spirit_mq.name: Spirit Temple MQ without Lens of Truth
lens_spirit_mq.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Spirit Temple MQ.

spirit_mq_sun_block_sot.name: Spirit Temple MQ Sun Block Room as Child without Song of Time
description: While adult can easily jump directly to the switch that unbars the door to the sun block room, child Link cannot make the jump without spawning a Song of Time block to jump from.

You can skip this by throwing the crate down onto the switch from above, which does unbar the door, however the crate immediately breaks, so you must move quickly to get through the door before it closes back up.

spirit_mq_sun_block_gs.name: Spirit Temple MQ Sun Block Room GS with Boomerang
spirit_mq_sun_block_gs.description: Throw the Boomerang in such a way that it curves through the side of the glass block to hit the Gold Skulltula.

spirit_mq_lower_adult.name: Spirit Temple MQ Lower Adult without Fire Arrows
spirit_mq_lower_adult.description: By standing in a precise position it is possible to light two of the torches with a single use of Din's Fire. This saves enough time to be able to light all three torches with only Din's Fire.

spirit_mq_frozen_eye.name: Spirit Temple MQ Frozen Eye Switch without Fire
spirit_mq_frozen_eye.description: You can melt the ice by shooting an arrow through a torch. The only way to find a line of sight for this shot is to first spawn a Song of Time block, and then stand on the very edge of it.

ice_stalagmite_clip.name: Ice Cavern Stalagmite Clips
ice_stalagmite_clip.description: Most stalagmites blocking path in Ice Cavern can be clipped past with basic movement. Also applies to Water Trial.

ice_stalagmite_hookshot.name: Ice Cavern Stalagmites with Hookshot
ice_stalagmite_hookshot.description: Shooting stalagmites with hookshot in the right way also breaks them. Also applies to Water Trial.

ice_block_gs.name: Ice Cavern Block Room GS with Hover Boots
ice_block_gs.description: The Hover Boots can be used to get in front of the Skulltula to kill it with a jumpslash. Then, the Hover Boots can again be used to obtain the Token, all without Hookshot or Boomerang.

ice_mq_red_ice_gs.name: Ice Cavern MQ Red Ice GS without Song of Time
ice_mq_red_ice_gs.description: If you side-hop into the perfect position, you can briefly stand on the platform with the red ice just long enough to dump some blue fire.

ice_mq_scarecrow.name: Ice Cavern MQ Scarecrow GS with No Additional Items
ice_mq_scarecrow.description: As adult a precise jump can be used to reach this alcove.

lens_gtg.name: Gerudo Training Ground without Lens of Truth
lens_gtg.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Gerudo Training Ground.

gtg_without_hookshot.name: Gerudo Training Ground Left Side Silver Rupees without Hookshot
description: After collecting the rest of the Silver Rupees in the room, you can reach the final Silver Rupee on the ceiling by being pulled up into it after getting grabbed by the Wallmaster. Then, you must also reach the exit of the room without the use of the Hookshot.
If you move quickly you can sneak past the edge of a flame wall before it can rise up to block you. To do so without taking damage is more precise.

gtg_fake_wall.name: Reach Gerudo Training Ground Fake Wall Ledge with Hover Boots
gtg_fake_wall.description: A precise Hover Boots use from the top of the chest can allow you to grab the ledge without needing the usual requirements. Logical Bunny Hood allows this to be done in default logic. In Master Quest, this always skips a Song of Time requirement. In Vanilla, this skips a Hookshot requirement, but is only relevant if "Gerudo Training Ground Left Side Silver Rupees without Hookshot" is enabled.

gtg_lava_jump.name: Gerudo Training Grounds Itemless Lava Room Jump
gtg_lava_jump.description: A precise rolling jump can be used to jump between all but the furthest platforms in the lava room.

gtg_statue_jump.name: Gerudo Training Grounds Statue Room Jump
gtg_statue_jump.description: A precise rolling jump or a jump and jumpslash can be used to jump from the upper ledge to one of the pillars in the eye statue room.

lens_gtg_mq.name: Gerudo Training Ground MQ without Lens of Truth
lens_gtg_mq.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Gerudo Training Ground MQ.

gtg_mq_with_hookshot.name: Gerudo Training Ground MQ Left Side Silver Rupees with Hookshot
gtg_mq_with_hookshot.description: The highest Silver Rupee can be obtained by hookshotting the target and then immediately jumpslashing toward the Rupee.

gtg_mq_without_hookshot.name: Gerudo Training Ground MQ Left Side Silver Rupees without Hookshot
description:
After collecting the rest of the Silver Rupees in the room, you can reach the final Silver Rupee on the ceiling by being pulled up into it after getting grabbed by the Wallmaster. The Wallmaster will not track you to directly underneath the rupee. You should take the last step to be under the rupee after the Wallmaster has begun its attempt to grab you.
Also included with this trick is that fact that the switch that unbars the door to the final chest of GTG can be hit without a projectile, using a precise jumpslash.
This trick supersedes "Gerudo Training Ground MQ Left Side Silver Rupees with Hookshot".

gtg_mq_lava_room.name: Navigate Gerudo Training Ground MQ Lava Room without Fire
description: It's possible to use the edges of the platforms, either with well placed jumps or Hover Boots, to cross sections of MQ GTG Lava Room without having fire to switch off the fire rings.

This allows you to clear the room using a combination of Din's Fire and either Hover Boots or Bunny Hood instead of Bow and allows you to reach the right of the maze using only Hookshot if the upper switch has been hit, among other things.

lens_ganon.name: Ganon's Castle without Lens of Truth
lens_ganon.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Ganon's Castle.

ganon_spirit_trial_hookshot.name: Spirit Trial without Hookshot
ganon_spirit_trial_hookshot.description: The highest rupee can be obtained as adult by performing a precise jump and a well-timed jumpslash off of an Armos.

lens_ganon_mq.name: Ganon's Castle MQ without Lens of Truth
lens_ganon_mq.description: Removes the requirements for the Lens of Truth in Ganon's Castle MQ.

ganon_mq_fire_trial.name: Fire Trial MQ with Hookshot
ganon_mq_fire_trial.description: It's possible to hook the target at the end of fire trial with just Hookshot, but it requires precise aim and perfect positioning. The main difficulty comes from getting on the very corner of the obelisk without falling into the lava.

ganon_mq_shadow_trial.name: Shadow Trial MQ Torch with Bow
ganon_mq_shadow_trial.description: You can light the torch in this room without a fire source by shooting an arrow through the lit torch at the beginning of the room. Because the room is so dark and the unlit torch is so far away, it can be difficult to aim the shot correctly.

ganon_mq_light_trial.name: Light Trial MQ without Hookshot
ganon_mq_light_trial.description: If you move quickly you can sneak past the edge of a flame wall before it can rise up to block you. In this case to do it without taking damage is especially precise.

language.title: UI Language
language.description: Changes PC menus and tools. Game dialogue and added in-game messages use Settings > General > Language independently.
language.translation_status: Untranslated entries use English. Japanese added-message rendering will be enabled in a later step.
language.catalog_error: UI catalogs are unavailable or outdated. Built-in English is active. Rebuild GenerateSohOtr, replace the soh.o2r used by this executable, and restart.

Theme.name: Menu Theme
Theme.description: Changes the Theme of the Menu Widgets.

BackgroundOpacity.name: Menu Background Opacity
BackgroundOpacity.description: Sets the opacity of the background of the port menu.

SidebarSearch.name: Search In Sidebar
SidebarSearch.description: Displays the Search menu as a sidebar entry in Settings instead of in the header.

SearchAutofocus.name: Search Input Autofocus
SearchAutofocus.description: Search input box gets autofocus when visible. Does not affect using other widgets.

Popout.name: Popout Menu
Popout.description: Changes the menu display from overlay to windowed.

CursorVisibility.name: Cursor Always Visible
CursorVisibility.description: Makes the cursor always visible, even in full screen.

BootSequence.name: Boot Sequence
BootSequence.description:
Configure what happens when starting or resetting the game.

Default: LUS logo -> N64 logo
Authentic: N64 logo only
File Select: Skip to file select menu
Debug Warp Screen: Skip to the debug warp screen
Warp Point: Skip to active warp point (if set), see Dev Tools -> General

Languages.name: Language
Languages.description: Selects original dialogue and added in-game messages. UI Language is configured separately.

A11yTTS.name: Text to Speech
A11yTTS.description: Enables text to speech for in-game dialogue

A11yDisableIdleCam.name: Disable Idle Camera Re-Centering
A11yDisableIdleCam.description: Disables the automatic re-centering of the camera when idle.

A11yNoScreenFlashForFinishingBlow.name: Disable Screen Flash for Finishing Blow
A11yNoScreenFlashForFinishingBlow.description: Disables the white screen flash on enemy kill.

A11yNoJabuWobble.name: Disable Jabu Wobble
A11yNoJabuWobble.description: Disable the geometry wobble and camera distortion inside Jabu.

A11yNoHeatHaze.name: Disable Heat Haze
A11yNoHeatHaze.description: Disable the heat haze distortion effect in Death Mountain / Fire Temple.

ImGuiScale.name: ImGui Menu Scaling
ImGuiScale.description: Changes the display scale of the PC menu.

MatchRefreshRate.name: Match Refresh Rate
MatchRefreshRate.description: Matches interpolation value to the refresh rate of your display.

Position.name: Position
Position.description: Which corner of the screen notifications appear in.

Duration.name: Duration (seconds):
Duration.description: How long notifications are displayed for.

BgOpacity.name: Background Opacity
BgOpacity.description: How opaque the background of notifications is.

Mute.name: Mute Notification Sound
Mute.description: Prevent notifications from playing a sound.

Enabled.name: Free Look
Enabled.description:
Enables free look camera control
Note: You must remap C buttons off of the right stick in the controller config menu, and map the camera stick to the right stick.
Doesn't work in areas were the game locks the camera.
Scene reload may be necessary to enable.

EnableMouse.name: Enable Mouse Controls
EnableMouse.description:
Allows for using the mouse to control the camera (must enable Free Look), aim with the shield, and perform quickspin attacks (quickly rotate the mouse then press B)
Press F2 to toggle mouse capture manually.

AutoCaptureMouse.name: Auto Capture Mouse Input
AutoCaptureMouse.description: When Mouse Controls are enabled, this toggles whether the program will automatically hide the cursor and capture mouse input when closing the menu.

DisableThirdPersonMouse.name: Disable Third-Person Mouse Controls
DisableThirdPersonMouse.description: Stops the mouse from moving the third-person camera and from triggering quickspins, while still allowing mouse control for first-person aiming and the shield.

DPadOnPause.name: D-pad Support on Pause Screen
DPadOnPause.description:
Navigate Pause with the D-pad
If used with "D-pad as Equip Items", you must hold C-Up to equip instead of navigate

DpadInText.name: D-pad Support in Text Boxes
DpadInText.description: Navigate choices in text boxes, shop item selection, and the file select / name entry screens with the D-pad

AltAssets.name: Enable Mods
AltAssets.description: Toggle mods. For graphics mods, this means toggling between default and mod graphics.

AlternateAssetsHotkey.name: Mods Tab Hotkey
AlternateAssetsHotkey.description: Allows pressing the Tab key to toggle mods

RandomizedEnemies.name: Enemy Randomizer
RandomizedEnemies.description:
Replaces fixed enemies throughout the game with a random enemy. Bosses, Mini-Bosses and a few specific regular enemies are excluded.
Enemies that need more than Deku Nuts & either Deku Sticks or a sword to kill are excluded from spawning in "clear enemy" rooms.

- Random: Enemies are randomized every time you load a room.
- Random (Seeded): Enemies are randomized based on the current randomizer seed/file.

RandomizedEnemySizes.name: Randomized Enemy Sizes
RandomizedEnemySizes.description: Enemies and Bosses spawn with random sizes.

EnemySizeScalesHealth.name: Scale Health with Size
EnemySizeScalesHealth.description:
Scales normal enemies Health with their randomized size.
*This will NOT affect Bosses!*

EnemyRandomizerAirWalkVoidouts.name: Enemies Walk over Voidout Pits
EnemyRandomizerAirWalkVoidouts.description:
Ground enemies will air walk over pits/floors that void out Link
to prevent softlocks. Can be toggled to make enemies fall down
or fly back up from a void pit.

Autosave.name: Autosave
Autosave.description:
Save the game automatically on a 3 minute interval and when soft-resetting the game. The interval autosave will wait if the game is paused in any way (dialogue, pause screen up, cutscenes, etc.).

The soft-reset save will *not* trigger in cutscene maps like the Chamber of Sages!

AutosaveNotification.name: Notification on Autosave
AutosaveNotification.description: Show a notification when the game is autosaved.

RememberSaveLocation.name: Remember Save Location
RememberSaveLocation.description:
When loading a save, places Link at the last entrance he went through.
This doesn't work if the save was made in grottos, fairy fountains, or dungeons.

BetterSaveMenu.name: Better Save Menu
BetterSaveMenu.description:
Replaces the authentic save menu with a textbox that asks Yes or No for saving,
then asks if you want to Continue, Reset, or Reset to Spawn.

ChestSizeAndTextureMatchContents.name: Containers Match Contents
ChestSizeAndTextureMatchContents.description:
Toggle to change container textures to match their contents in randomizer games.
Categories: Major items, Lesser items, Junk items, Small keys, Boss keys, Skulltula Tokens.

ChestSizeDependsStoneOfAgony.name: Containers of Agony
ChestSizeDependsStoneOfAgony.description: Only change the texture of containers if you have the Stone of Agony.

NightGSAlwaysSpawn.name: Nighttime GS Always Spawn
NightGSAlwaysSpawn.description: Nighttime Skulltulas will spawn during both day and night.

DayGravePull.name: Pull Grave During the Day
DayGravePull.description: Allows graves to be pulled when child during the day.

DampeAllNight.name: Dampe Appears All Night
DampeAllNight.description: Makes Dampe appear anytime during the night, not just his usual working hours.

MarketSneak.name: Exit Market at Night
MarketSneak.description: Allows exiting Hyrule Castle Market Town to Hyrule Field at night by speaking to the guard next to the gate.

OpenAllHours.name: Shops and Games Always Open
OpenAllHours.description: Shops and Minigames are open both day and night. Requires a scene reload to take effect.

disabled_messages.default: This is not compatible with the Locked Overworld Doors Randomizer option.

PauseAnyCursor.name: Allow the Cursor to be on Any Slot
PauseAnyCursor.description: Allows the cursor on the pause menu to be over any slot. Sometimes required in Randomizer to select certain items.

PauseWarp.name: Pause Warp
PauseWarp.description: Selection of warp song in pause menu initiates a warp. Disables song playback.

NaviOnL.name: Answer Navi Prompt with L Button
NaviOnL.description: Speak to Navi with L but enter First-Person Camera with C-Up.

NoInputForCredits.name: Don't Require Input for Credits Sequence
NoInputForCredits.description: Removes the Input Requirement on Text boxes after defeating Ganon, allowing the Credits Sequence to continue to progress.

IncludeHeldInputsBufferWindow.name: Include Held Inputs at the Start of Pause Buffer Input Window
IncludeHeldInputsBufferWindow.description: Typically, inputs that are held prior to the buffer window are not included in the buffer. This setting changes that behavior to include them. This may cause some inputs to be re-triggered undesireably, for instance Z-Targeting something you might not want to.

PauseBufferWindow.name: Pause Buffer Input Window: %d frames
PauseBufferWindow.description: Adds back in a delay after unpausing before the game resumes playing again, where inputs can be held prematurely to be input immediately after the game resumes. This essentially brings back behaviour from console releases which are lost on default because SoH isn't limited to N64 hardware.

Enabled.name: Reworked Targeting
Enabled.description:
Reworks targeting functionality
- Press Z while locked always untargets (in Toggle mode)
- Use the configured button combo to switch between targets

DisableCritWiggle.name: Disable Crit Wiggle
DisableCritWiggle.description: Disable Random Camera Wiggle at Low Health.

BetterOwl.name: Better Owl
BetterOwl.description: The default response to Kaepora Gaebora is always that you understood what he said.

EasyButterflyFairies.name: Easy Butterfly Fairies
EasyButterflyFairies.description: Butterflies will transform into a fairy as soon as you approach them with a Deku Stick, skipping the need to stand still and let the butterfly land on your stick.

DropThrowOnlyObjects.name: Allow Dropping Throw-Only Objects
DropThrowOnlyObjects.description: Allows normally throw-only objects (such as Cuccos, pots, grass, and small rocks) to be dropped by pressing A while standing still. Can be toggled while holding an object.

QuitFishingAtDoor.name: Quit Fishing at Door
QuitFishingAtDoor.description: Fisherman asks if you want to quit at the door if you try to leave the Fishing Pond while still holding the Fishing Rod.

InstantPutaway.name: Instant Putaway
InstantPutaway.description: Allow Link to put items away without having to wait around.

ResetNaviTimer.name: Navi Timer Resets on Scene Change
ResetNaviTimer.description: Resets the Navi timer on scene change. If you have already talked to her, she will try and talk to you again, instead of needing a save warp or death.

CowOfTime.name: Link's Cow in Both Time Periods
CowOfTime.description: Allows the Lon Lon Ranch Obstacle Course reward to be shared across time periods.

SleepingWaterfall.name: Play Zelda's Lullaby to Open Sleeping Waterfall
SleepingWaterfall.description:
Always: Link must always play Zelda's Lullaby to open the waterfall entrance to Zora's Domain.
Once: Link only needs to play Zelda's Lullaby once to open the waterfall; after that, it stays open permanently.
Never: Link never needs to play Zelda's Lullaby to open the waterfall. He only needs to have learned it and have an Ocarina.

SkipJabuJabuFish.name: Skip Feeding Jabu-Jabu
SkipJabuJabuFish.description: Allow Link to enter Jabu-Jabu without feeding him a fish.

OnePoint.name: Skip One Point Cutscenes (Chests, Door Unlocks, etc.)

GlitchAiding.name: Exclude Glitch-Aiding Cutscenes
GlitchAiding.description: Don't skip cutscenes that are associated with useful glitches. Currently, it is only the Fire Temple Darunia CS, Forest Temple Poe Sisters CS, Dodongo Boss Door Switch CS, Water Temple Dragon Switch CS, the Box Skip One Point in Jabu, Early Hammer Switch CS in MQ Spirit, and Cow Switch Chest CS in MQ Jabu.

SkipForcedDialog.name: Skip Forced Dialog
SkipForcedDialog.description: Prevent forced conversations with Navi and/or other NPCs.

SkipChildStealth.name: Skip Child Stealth
SkipChildStealth.description: The crawlspace into Hyrule Castle goes straight to Zelda, skipping the guards.

SkipTowerEscape.name: Skip Tower Escape
SkipTowerEscape.description: Skip the tower escape sequence between Ganondorf and Ganon.

WarpSongSkipAnimation.name: Skip Warp Cutscenes
WarpSongSkipAnimation.description: Warp songs skip the departure and arrival cutscenes, fading immediately to the destination.

FastBottles.name: Skip Bottle Pickup Messages
FastBottles.description: Skip Pickup Messages for Bottle Swipes.

FastDrops.name: Skip Consumable Item Pickup Messages
FastDrops.description: Skip Pickup Messages for new Consumable Items.

SlowTextSpeed.name: Slow Text Speed: %dx
SlowTextSpeed.description: Changes the speed of sections of text that normally are paced slower than the text surrounding it.

FasterHeavyBlockLift.name: Faster Heavy Block Lift
FasterHeavyBlockLift.description: Speeds up lifting Silver Rocks and Obelisks.

FasterShadowShip.name: Faster Shadow Ship
FasterShadowShip.description: Speeds up ship in Shadow Temple.

FastChests.name: Fast Chests
FastChests.description: Makes Link always kick the chest to open it, instead of doing the longer chest opening animation for major items.

ImprovedRoll.name: Improved Roll
ImprovedRoll.description: Allows Link to chain a new roll by pressing A during a roll, maintaining maximum roll speed.

ImprovedRollSteering.name: Improved Roll Steering
ImprovedRollSteering.description: Allows slight directional steering with the control stick while rolling. Steering is automatically disabled while Z is held, preserving Z-target roll glitch setups.

SkipSwimDeepEndAnim.name: Skip Water Take Breath Animation
SkipSwimDeepEndAnim.description: Skips Link's taking breath animation after coming up from water. This setting does not interfere with getting items from underwater.

FasterBottleEmpty.name: Empty Bottles Faster
FasterBottleEmpty.description: Speeds up emptying animation when dumping out the contents of a bottle.

GlitchAidingCrawlspaces.name: Exclude Glitch-Aiding Crawlspaces
GlitchAidingCrawlspaces.description:
Don't increase crawl speed when exiting glitch-useful crawlspaces.
Currently it is only the BOTW crawlspace to a locked door.

MweepSpeed.name: King Zora Speed: %.2fx
MweepSpeed.description: Increase the speed of King Zora's move animation ("mweep")

FasterPauseMenu.name: Faster Pause Menu
FasterPauseMenu.description: Speeds up animation of the pause menu, similar to Majora's Mask

InstantScarecrow.name: Skip Playing Scarecrow's Song
InstantScarecrow.description:
Pierre appears when an Ocarina is pulled out. Requires learning the Scarecrow's Song first.
Without the randomizer option "Start with Scarecrow's Song" enabled for a seed, this still requires you to teach the scarecrow the song as both ages before summoning.

FasterRupeeAccumulator.name: Faster Rupee Accumulator
FasterRupeeAccumulator.description: Causes your Wallet to fill and empty faster when you gain or lose money.

SkulltulaFreeze.name: No Skulltula Freeze
SkulltulaFreeze.description: Stops the game from freezing the player when picking up Gold Skulltula Tokens. Does not apply in randomizer savefiles.

LinkDefaultName.name: Link as Default File Name
LinkDefaultName.description: Allows you to have "Link" as a premade file name.

FasterBeanSkull.name: Spawn Bean Skulltula Faster
FasterBeanSkull.description: Makes Gold Skulltulas come out of bean patches faster after bugs dig into the center.

ForgeTime.name: Biggoron Forge Time: %d days
ForgeTime.description: Allows you to change the number of days it takes for Biggoron to forge the Biggoron's Sword.

DisableBombBillboarding.name: Disable Bomb Billboarding
DisableBombBillboarding.description: Disables bombs always rotating to face the camera. To be used in conjunction with mods that want to replace bombs with 3D objects.

DisableGrottoRotation.name: Disable Grotto Fixed Rotation
DisableGrottoRotation.description: Disables Grottos rotating with the Camera. To be used in conjunction with mods that want to replace grottos with 3D objects.

DisableLinkSwordTrail.name: Disable Link's Sword Trail
DisableLinkSwordTrail.description: Disables the sword trail effect when swinging Link's sword. Useful when using mods that replace Link's sword model.

3DSceneRender.name: Disable 2D Pre-Rendered Scenes
3DSceneRender.description:
Disables 2D pre-rendered backgrounds. Enable this when using a mod that implements 3D backdrops for these areas.
Requires Scene Change to alter.

DisableFixedCamera.name: Disable Fixed Camera
DisableFixedCamera.description:
Disables the fixed camera in maps that use 2D pre-rendered backgrounds. Enable this when using a mod that implements 3D backdrops for these areas.
Requires Scene Change to alter.

TextSpacing.name: Ingame Text Spacing: %d
TextSpacing.description: Space between text characters (useful for HD font textures).

DisableLOD.name: Disable LOD
DisableLOD.description: Turns off the Level of Detail setting, making models use their Higher-Poly variants at any distance.

EnemyHealthBar.name: Enemy Health Bars
EnemyHealthBar.description: Renders a health bar for Enemies when Z-Targeted.

NewDrops.name: Enable 3D Dropped Items/Projectiles
NewDrops.description: Replaces most 2D items and projectiles on the overworld with their equivalent 3D models.

PauseMenuAnimatedLink.name: Animated Link in Pause Menu
PauseMenuAnimatedLink.description: Turns the Static Image of Link in the Pause Menu's Equipment Subscreen into a model cycling through his idle animations.

EquipmentAlwaysVisible.name: Show Age-Dependent Equipment
EquipmentAlwaysVisible.description: Makes all equipment visible, regardless of age.

ScaleAdultEquipmentAsChild.name: Scale Adult Equipment as Child
ScaleAdultEquipmentAsChild.description: Scales all of the Adult Equipment, as well as moving some a bit, to fit on Child Link better. May not work properly with some mods.

FirstPersonGauntlets.name: Show Gauntlets in First-Person
FirstPersonGauntlets.description: Renders Gauntlets when using the Bow and Hookshot like in OoT3D.

ShowDoorLocksOnBothSides.name: Show Chains on Both Sides of Locked Doors

ToTMedallionsColors.name: Color Temple of Time's Medallions
ToTMedallionsColors.description: When Medallions are collected, the Medallion imprints around the Master Sword Pedestal in the Temple of Time will become colored-in.

MinimalUI.name: Minimal UI
MinimalUI.description:
Hides most of the UI when not needed.
NOTE: Doesn't activate until scene transition.

DisableTunicWarningText.name: Disable Hot/Underwater Warning Text
DisableTunicWarningText.description: Disables warning text when you don't have the Goron/Zora Tunic on in Hot/Underwater conditions.

RememberMapToggleState.name: Remember Minimap State Between Areas
RememberMapToggleState.description: Preserve the minimap visibility state when going between areas rather than default it to "on" when going through loading zones.

VisualAgony.name: Visual Stone of Agony
VisualAgony.description: Displays an icon and plays a sound when Stone of Agony should be activated, for those without rumble.

NoHUDHeartAnimation.name: Disable HUD Heart Animations
NoHUDHeartAnimation.description: Disables the Beating Animation of the Hearts on the HUD.

DrawLineupTick.name: Glitch Line-up Tick
DrawLineupTick.description: Displays a tick in the top center of the screen to help with glitch line-ups in SoH, since traditional UI based line-ups do not work outside of 4:3

DisableBlackBars.name: Disable Black Bar Letterboxes
DisableBlackBars.description: Disables Black Bar Letterboxes during cutscenes and Z-Targeting. NOTE: There may be minor visual glitches that were covered up by the black bars. Please disable this setting before reporting a bug.

DynamicWalletIcon.name: Dynamic Wallet Icon
DynamicWalletIcon.description: Changes the Rupee in the Wallet icon to match the wallet size you currently have.

AlwaysShowDungeonMinimapIcon.name: Always Show Dungeon Entrances
AlwaysShowDungeonMinimapIcon.description: Always shows dungeon entrance icons on the Minimap.

BetterAmmoRendering.name: Better Ammo Rendering in Pause Menu
BetterAmmoRendering.description: Ammo counts in the pause menu will work correctly regardless of the position of items in the Inventory.

MoreInfo.name: More Info
MoreInfo.description: Shows what items you have collected in the File Select screen, like in N64 Randomizer.

TimeFlow.name: Enable Passage of Time
TimeFlow.description: The skybox in the background of the File Select screen will go through the day and night cycle over time.

HideNormalQuest.name: Hide Original
HideNormalQuest.description: Hides the original game when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

HideMasterQuest.name: Hide Master Quest
HideMasterQuest.description: Hides the Master Quest option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

HideRandomizerQuest.name: Hide Randomizer
HideRandomizerQuest.description: Hides the Randomizer option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

HideBossRushQuest.name: Hide Boss Rush
HideBossRushQuest.description: Hides the Boss Rush option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

HideSpeedrunQuest.name: Hide Speedrun
HideSpeedrunQuest.description: Hides the Speedrun option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

HideSpeedrunMasterQuest.name: Hide Speedrun Master Quest
HideSpeedrunMasterQuest.description: Hides the Speedrun Master Quest option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

RemoveSpinAttackDarkness.name: Remove Spin Attack Darkness
RemoveSpinAttackDarkness.description: Remove the Darkness that appears when charging a Spin Attack.

DisableLinkSpinWithGoronPot.name: Disable Link Spinning With Goron Pot
DisableLinkSpinWithGoronPot.description: Link will not spin when the Goron Pot starts to spin.

DisableDrawDistance.name: Increase Actor Draw Distance: %dx
DisableDrawDistance.description: Increases the range in which Actors/Objects are drawn.

DisableKokiriDrawDistance.name: Disable Kokiri Fade
DisableKokiriDrawDistance.description: The Kokiri are mystical beings that fade into view when approached. Enabling this will remove their draw distance.

WidescreenActorCulling.name: Widescreen Actor Culling
WidescreenActorCulling.description: Adjusts the Horizontal Culling Plane to account for Widescreen Resolutions.

ExtendedCullingExcludeGlitchActors.name: Cull Glitch Useful Actors
ExtendedCullingExcludeGlitchActors.description:
Exclude Actors that are useful for Glitches from the extended culling ranges. Some actors may still draw in the extended ranges, but will not "update" so that certain glitches that leverage the original culling requirements will still work.

The following actors are excluded:
 - White Clothed Gerudos
 - King Zora
 - Gossip Stones
 - Boulders
 - Blue Warps
 - Darunia
 - Gold Skulltulas

DpadEquips.name: Equip Items on Dpad
DpadEquips.description: Equip items and equipment on the D-pad. If used with "D-pad on Pause Screen", you must hold C-Up to equip instead of navigate.

ItemUnequip.name: Allow unequipping Items
ItemUnequip.description: Allows unequipping items from C-Buttons/D-pad by hovering over an equipped item and pressing the button it's equipped to.

AssignableTunicsAndBoots.name: Assignable Shields, Tunics and Boots
AssignableTunicsAndBoots.description: Allows equipping Shields, Tunics and Boots to C-Buttons/D-pad.

EquipmentCanBeRemoved.name: Equipment Toggle
EquipmentCanBeRemoved.description: Allows equipment to be removed by toggling it on/off in the equipment subscreen.

ToggleStrength.name: Allow Strength Equipment to be Toggled
ToggleStrength.description: Allows Strength to be toggled on and off by pressing A on the Strength Upgrade in the Equipment Subscreen of the Pause Menu. This allows performing some glitches that require the player to not have Strength.

UnsheatheWithoutSlashing.name: Unsheathe Sword Without Slashing
UnsheatheWithoutSlashing.description: Allows Link to unsheathe the sword without slashing automatically.

SwordToggle.name: Sword Toggle Options
SwordToggle.description:
Introduces Options for unequipping Link's sword

None: Only Biggoron's Sword/Giant's Knife can be toggled. Doing so will equip the Master Sword.

Child Toggle: This will allow for completely unequipping any sword as Child link.

Both Ages: Any sword can be unequipped as either age. This may lead to swordless glitches as adult.

AskToEquip.name: Ask to Equip New Items
AskToEquip.description: Adds a prompt to equip newly-obtained Swords, Shields, and Tunics.

DpadNoDropOcarinaInput.name: Prevent Dropped Ocarina Inputs
DpadNoDropOcarinaInput.description: Prevent dropping inputs when playing the Ocarina too quickly.

FastOcarinaPlayback.name: Fast Ocarina Playback
FastOcarinaPlayback.description: Skip the part where the Ocarina Playback is called when you play a song.

TimeTravel.name: Time Travel with Song of Time
TimeTravel.description:
Allows Link to freely change age by playing the Song of Time.
Time Blocks can still be used properly.

Requirements:
 - Obtained the Song of Time
 - Obtained the Ocarina of Time (depends on selection)
 - Obtained the Master Sword (depends on selection)
 - Not within range of a Time Block
 - Not within range of Ocarina Playing spots

MMBunnyHood.name: Bunny Hood Effect
MMBunnyHood.description:
Wearing the Bunny Hood grants a speed and jump boost like in Majora's Mask.
Can also be limited to only the speed boost.
Randomizer logic only accounts for this when the seed's own "Bunny Hood Effect" setting is on.
Also disables NPC's reactions to wearing the Bunny Hood.

AdultMasks.name: Masks Equippable as Adult
AdultMasks.description:
Allows masks to be equipped normally from the pause menu as adult.
Randomizer logic only accounts for this when the seed's own "Masks as Adult" setting is on.

PersistentMasks.name: Persistent Masks
PersistentMasks.description:
Stops masks from automatically unequipping in certain situations:
- When entering a new scene
- When not in any C-Button or the D-pad
- When saving and quitting
- When dying
- When traveling through time (if "Masks Equippable as Adult" is activated)

HideBunnyHood.name: Invisible Bunny Hood
HideBunnyHood.description: Turns Bunny Hood Invisible while still maintaining its effects.

MaskSelect.name: Mask Select in Inventory
MaskSelect.description: After completing the mask trading sub-quest, press A and any direction on the mask slot to change masks.

RemoteBombchu.name: Remote Bombchu
RemoteBombchu.description:
Allows you to control a Bombchu after dropping it.
Control Stick: Steer
B: Detonate
A: Quit Control

NutsExplodeBombs.name: Deku Nuts Explode Bombs
NutsExplodeBombs.description: Make Deku Nuts explode Bombs, similar to how they interact with Bombchus. This does not affect Bomb Flowers.

RemoveExplosiveLimit.name: Remove Explosive Limit
RemoveExplosiveLimit.description: Removes the cap of 3 active explosives being deployed at once.

StaticExplosionRadius.name: Static Explosion Radius
StaticExplosionRadius.description: Explosions are now a static size, like in Majora's Mask and OoT3D. Makes Bombchu hovering much easier.

DisableFirstPersonChus.name: Prevent Bombchus Forcing First-Person
DisableFirstPersonChus.description: Prevent Bombchus from forcing the camera into first-person mode when released.

BetterBombchuShopping.name: Better Bombchu Shopping
BetterBombchuShopping.description: Bombchus do not sell out when bought, and a 10 pack of Bombchus costs 99 rupees instead of 100.

SeparateArrows.name: Equip Multiple Arrows at Once
SeparateArrows.description: Allow the Bow and Magic Arrows to be equipped at the same time on different slots. NOTE: This will disable the behavior of the 'Equip Dupe' glitch.

BlueFireArrows.name: Blue Fire Arrows
BlueFireArrows.description: Allows Ice Arrows to melt Red Ice. May require a room reload if toggled during gameplay.

SunlightArrows.name: Sunlight Arrows
SunlightArrows.description: Allows Light Arrows to activate Sun Switches. May require a room reload if toggled during gameplay.

BowSlingshotAmmoFix.name: Bow as Child/Slingshot as Adult
BowSlingshotAmmoFix.description:
Allows Child Link to use a Bow with Arrows.
Allows Adult Link to use a Slingshot with Seeds.

Requires glitches or the 'Timeless Equipment' cheat to equip.

BowReticle.name: Aiming Reticle for the Bow/Slingshot
BowReticle.description: Aiming with a Bow or Slingshot will display a reticle as with the Hookshot when the projectile is ready to fire.

BowArrowCycle.name: Arrow Cycle
BowArrowCycle.description: Allows cycling between different arrow types (Normal, Fire, Ice, Light) while aiming the bow. Press the R button to cycle to the next available arrow type. Only works when aiming and only cycles to arrow types you own with sufficient magic.

HookshotableReticle.name: Targetable Hookshot Reticle
HookshotableReticle.description: Makes the Hookshot Reticle use a different color when aiming at hookshotable collision.

FastBoomerang.name: Instant Boomerang Recall
FastBoomerang.description: Instantly return the Boomerang to Link by pressing its item button while it's in the air.

BoomerangFirstPerson.name: Aim Boomerang in First-Person Mode
BoomerangFirstPerson.description: Change aiming for the Boomerang from Third-Person to First-Person to see past Link's head.

BoomerangReticle.name: Aiming Reticle for Boomerang
BoomerangReticle.description: Aiming with the Boomerang will display a reticle as with the Hookshot.

BetterFarore.name: Better Farore's Wind
BetterFarore.description: Helps FW persist between ages, gives Child and Adult separate FW points, and can be used in more places.

FastFarores.name: Faster Farore's Wind
FastFarores.description: Greatly decreases cast time of Farore's Wind magic spell.

RebottleBlueFire.name: Rebottle Blue Fire
RebottleBlueFire.description: Blue Fire dropped from a bottle can be bottled.

GravediggingTourFix.name: Fix the Gravedigging Tour Glitch
GravediggingTourFix.description: Fixes a bug where the Gravedigging Tour Heart Piece disappears if the area reloads.

FixDampeGoingBackwards.name: Fix Dampé Going Backwards
FixDampeGoingBackwards.description: Fixes Dampé going backwards in certain circumstances when the player is going backwards.

FixKokiriForestQuestState.name: Fix Kokiri Forest Quest State
FixKokiriForestQuestState.description: Fixes Kokiri animation state to match their text state when getting Zelda's Letter before Kokiri Emerald.

FixFloorSwitches.name: Fix Raised Floor Switches
FixFloorSwitches.description: Fixes the two raised floor switches, the one in the Forest Temple basement and the one at the top of the Fire Temple. This will lower them, making activating them easier.

FixZoraHintDialogue.name: Fix Zora Hint Dialogue
FixZoraHintDialogue.description: Fixes one Zora's dialogue giving a hint about bringing Ruto's Letter to King Zora to properly occur before moving King Zora rather than after.

FixVineFall.name: Fix Falling from Vine Edges
FixVineFall.description: Prevents immediately falling off climbable surfaces if climbing on the edges.

BushDropFix.name: Fix Bush Item Drops
BushDropFix.description: Fixes the bushes to drop items correctly rather than spawning undefined items.

FixFlexDrops.name: Fix Flex Drops
FixFlexDrops.description: The flex drop gives whichever ammo you are lowest on, but doesn't check that you own the item to hold it, so the drop is lost. This makes it skip ammo you can't carry.

EnemySpawnsOverWaterboxes.name: Fix Enemies not Spawning Near Water
EnemySpawnsOverWaterboxes.description: Causes respawning enemies, like Stalchildren, to appear on land near bodies of water. Fixes an incorrect calculation that acted like water underneath ground was above it.

FixSawSoftlock.name: Fix Poacher's Saw Softlock
FixSawSoftlock.description: Prevents the Poacher's Saw softlock from mashing through the text, or with Skip Text enabled.

AnubisFix.name: Fix Anubis Fireballs
AnubisFix.description: Make Anubis Fireballs do Fire damage when reflected back at them with the Mirror Shield.

GCDoorsAfterFireFix.name: Fix Goron City Doors After Fire Temple
GCDoorsAfterFireFix.description: Forces Goron City doors open if you somehow complete Fire Temple without talking to Goron Link and receiving the Goron Tunic.

MQWaterLockFix.name: Fix MQ Water 1F Lock
MQWaterLockFix.description:
The second small key lock in MQ Water Temple is removed before the player can reach it by a shared flag with some Stalfos on the way to Dark Link.
Enabling this will cause that lock to use a different flag, working as intended.

DekuNutUpgradeFix.name: Fix Deku Nut Upgrade
DekuNutUpgradeFix.description: Prevents the Forest Stage Deku Nut upgrade from becoming unobtainable after receiving the Poacher's Saw.

CrouchStabHammerFix.name: Fix Megaton Hammer Crouch Stab
CrouchStabHammerFix.description: Make the Megaton Hammer's crouch stab able to destroy rocks without first swinging it normally.

CrouchStabFix.name: Remove Power Crouch Stab
CrouchStabFix.description: Make crouch stabbing always do the same damage as a regular slash.

FixBrokenGiantsKnife.name: Fix Broken Giant's Knife Bug
FixBrokenGiantsKnife.description: Fixes the Broken Giant's Knife flag not being reset when Medigoron fixes it.

FixCameraDrift.name: Fix Camera Drift
FixCameraDrift.description: Fixes camera slightly drifting to the left when standing still due to a math error. May impact certain glitches.

FixCameraSwing.name: Fix Camera Swing
FixCameraSwing.description: Fixes camera getting stuck on collision when standing still. Also fixes slight shift back in camera when Link stops moving. May impact certain glitches.

FixHangingLedgeSwingRate.name: Fix Hanging Ledge Swing Rate
FixHangingLedgeSwingRate.description: Fixes camera swing rate when the player falls off a ledge and the camera swings around. May impact certain glitches.

FixMenuLR.name: Fix L&R Pause Menu
FixMenuLR.description: Makes the L and R buttons in the pause menu the same color.

FixDungeonMinimapIcon.name: Fix Dungeon Entrances
FixDungeonMinimapIcon.description: Removes the Dungeon Entrance icon on the top-left corner of the screen when no dungeon is present on the current map.

TwoHandedIdle.name: Fix Two-Handed Idle Animations
TwoHandedIdle.description: Re-Enables the two-handed idle animation, a seemingly finished animation that was disabled on accident in the original game.

NaviTextFix.name: Fix Navi Text HUD Position
NaviTextFix.description: Correctly centers the Navi text prompt on the HUD's C-Up button.

GerudoWarriorClothingFix.name: Fix Gerudo Warrior's Clothing Colors
GerudoWarriorClothingFix.description: Prevent the Gerudo Warrior's clothes changing color when changing Link's tunic or using bombs in front of her.

FixTexturesOOB.name: Fix Out of Bounds Textures
FixTexturesOOB.description: Fixes authentic out of bounds texture reads, instead loading textures with the correct size.

FixEyesOpenWhileSleeping.name: Fix Link's Eyes Open while Sleeping
FixEyesOpenWhileSleeping.description: Fixes Link's eyes being open in the opening cutscene when he is supposed to be sleeping.

FixHammerHand.name: Fix Hand Holding Hammer
FixHammerHand.description: Fixes Adult Link having a backwards left hand when holding the Megaton Hammer.

SceneSpecificDirtPathFix.name: Fix Vanishing Paths
SceneSpecificDirtPathFix.description:
Disabled: Paths vanish more the higher the resolution (Z-Fighting is based on resolution).
Consistent: Certain paths vanish the same way in all resolutions.
No Vanish: Paths do not vanish, Link seems to sink in to some paths.
This might affect other decal effects.

SilverRupeeJingleExtend.name: Fix Missing Jingle after 5 Silver Rupees
SilverRupeeJingleExtend.description: Adds 5 higher pitches for the Silver Rupee Jingle for the rooms with more than 5 Silver Rupees. Only relevant for playthroughs involving Master Quest Dungeons.

FixDaruniaDanceSpeed.name: Fix Darunia Dancing too Fast
FixDaruniaDanceSpeed.description: Fixes Darunia's dancing speed so he dances to the beat of Saria's Song, like in the Original Game.

CreditsFix.name: Fix Credits Timing (PAL)
CreditsFix.description: Extend certain credits scenes so the music lines up properly with the visuals. (PAL only)

RedGanonBlood.name: Red Ganon Blood
RedGanonBlood.description: Restore the original red blood from NTSC 1.0/1.1. Disable for Green blood.

GSCutscene.name: Restore Old Gold Skulltula Cutscene
GSCutscene.description: Restore pre-release behavior where defeating a Gold Skulltula will play a cutscene showing it die.

PulsateBossIcon.name: Pulsate Boss Icon
PulsateBossIcon.description: Restores an unfinished feature to pulsate the boss room icon when you are in the boss room.

SariaGestureFriendsForever.name: Saria's Friends Forever Gesture
SariaGestureFriendsForever.description: Restores an unused animation of Saria when she says, "Saria and Link will be friends forever."

HoverFishing.name: Fish while Hovering
HoverFishing.description: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows casting the Fishing Rod while using the Hover Boots.

N64WeirdFrames.name: N64 Weird Frames
N64WeirdFrames.description: Restores N64 Weird Frames allowing weirdshots and weirdslides to behave the same as N64.

BombchusOOB.name: Bombchus Out of Bounds
BombchusOOB.description: Allows Bombchus to explode out of bounds. Similar to GameCube and Wii VC.

QuickPutaway.name: Quick Putaway
QuickPutaway.description: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows putting away an item without an animation and performing Putaway Ocarina Items.

QuickBongoKill.name: Quick Bongo Kill
QuickBongoKill.description: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows bypassing Bongo Bongo's intro cutscene to quickly kill him.

EarlyEyeballFrog.name: Early Eyeball Frog
EarlyEyeballFrog.description: Restores a bug from NTSC 1.0/1.1 that allows you to obtain the eyeball frog from King Zora instead of the Zora Tunic by Holding Shield.

ChildHookshotSoftlock.name: Child Hookshot Softlock
ChildHookshotSoftlock.description: Using the Hookshot as child softlocks.

GetItemManipulation.name: Get Item Manipulation
GetItemManipulation.description:
Restores Get Item Manipulation.
NTSC and PAL have separate tables.

NGCKaleidoSwitcher.name: Fix L&Z Page Switch in Pause Menu
NGCKaleidoSwitcher.description: Makes L and R switch pages like on the GameCube. Z opens the Debug Menu instead.

WideShutterDoorRange.name: Wide Door Ranges
WideShutterDoorRange.description:
Restores the wider range of certain shutter doors from NTSC 1.0.
Notably affects Jabu-Jabu and boss doors.

GraveHoles.name: Grave Hole Jumps
GraveHoles.description: Restores NTSC 1.0 behavior where Link jumps over grave holes and grabs the ledges.

PermanentHeartLoss.name: Permanent Heart Loss
PermanentHeartLoss.description:
When you lose 4 quarters of a heart you will permanently lose that Heart Container.

Disabling this after the fact will restore your Heart Containers.

DamageMult.name: Damage Multiplier
DamageMult.description:
Modifies all sources of damage not affected by other sliders:
2x: Can survive all common attacks from the start of the game.
4x: Dies in 1 hit to any substantial attack from the start of the game.
8x: Can only survive trivial damage from the start of the game.
16x: Can survive all common attacks with max health without double defense.
32x: Can survive all common attacks with max health and double defense.
64x: Can survive trivial damage with max health without double defense.
128x: Can survive trivial damage with max health and double defense.
256x: Cannot survive damage.

FallDamageMult.name: Fall Damage Multiplier
FallDamageMult.description:
Modifies all fall damage:
2x: Can survive all fall damage from the start of the game.
4x: Can only survive short fall damage from the start of the game.
8x: Cannot survive any fall damage from the start of the game.
16x: Can survive all fall damage with max health without double defense.
32x: Can survive all fall damage with max health and double defense.
64x: Can survive short fall damage with double defense.
128x: Cannot survive fall damage.

VoidDamageMult.name: Void Damage Multiplier
VoidDamageMult.description:
Modifies damage taken after falling into a void:
2x: Can survive void damage from the start of the game.
4x: Cannot survive void damage from the start of the game.
8x: Can survive void damage twice with max health without double defense.
16x: Can survive void damage with max health without double defense.
32x: Can survive void damage with max health and double defense.
64x: Cannot survive void damage.

FullHealthSpawn.name: Spawn with Full Health
FullHealthSpawn.description: Respawn with Full Health instead of 3 hearts.

NoHeartDrops.name: No Heart Drops
NoHeartDrops.description:
Disables Heart Drops, but not Heart Placements, like from a Deku Scrub running off.
This simulates Hero Mode from other games in the series.

NoRandomDrops.name: No Random Drops
NoRandomDrops.description: Disables Random Drops, except from the Goron Pot, Dampe, and Bosses.

EnableBombchuDrops.name: Enable Bombchu Drops
EnableBombchuDrops.description: Bombchus will sometimes drop in place of Bombs.

TreesDropSticks.name: Trees Drop Sticks
TreesDropSticks.description: Bonking into Trees will have a chance to drop up to 3 Sticks. Must have obtained sticks previously.

DampeDropRate.name: Dampe Drop Rate
DampeDropRate.description: Adjusts rate Dampe drops flames during race.

SwitchTimerMultiplier.name: Switch Timer Multiplier
SwitchTimerMultiplier.description: -5 will be half as much time, +5 will be 6x as much time. Affects timed switches, torches, GTG statue eyes, & doors in race with Dampe.

HazardTimerMin.name: Minimum Heat/Water Timer: %d seconds
HazardTimerMin.description: Limits how low heat timer or underwater timer can start.

GoronPot.name: Always Win Goron Pot
GoronPot.description: Always get the Heart Piece/Purple Rupee from the Spinning Goron Pot.

DampeWin.name: Always Win Dampe Digging Game
DampeWin.description: Always win the Heart Piece/Purple Rupee on the first dig in Dampe's Grave Digging game. In a Randomizer file, this defaults to on if this enhancement has never been changed.

AllDogsRichard.name: All Dogs are Richard
AllDogsRichard.description: All dogs can be traded in and will count as Richard.

CuccoStayDurationMult.name: Cuccos Stay Put Multiplier: %dx
CuccoStayDurationMult.description: Cuccos will stay in place longer after putting them down, by a multiple of the value of the slider.

CuccosToReturn.name: Cuccos Needed By Anju: %d
CuccosToReturn.description: The amount of cuccos needed to receive the bottle from Anju the Cucco Lady.

HyperBosses.name: Hyper Bosses
HyperBosses.description: All Major Bosses move and act twice as fast.

HyperEnemies.name: Hyper Enemies
HyperEnemies.description: All Regular Enemies and Mini-Bosses move and act twice as fast.

LeeverSpawnRate.name: Leever Spawn Rate: %d seconds
LeeverSpawnRate.description: The time between groups of Leevers spawning.

CustomizeShootingGallery.name: Customize Behavior
CustomizeShootingGallery.description: Turn on/off changes to the shooting gallery behavior.

ConstantAdultGallery.name: No Rupee Randomization
ConstantAdultGallery.description: Forces the rupee order to not be randomized as adult, making it the same as child.

ShootingGalleryAmmoChild.name: Child Starting Ammunition: %d seeds
ShootingGalleryAmmoChild.description: The ammunition at the start of the Shooting Gallery minigame as Child.

ShootingGalleryAmmoAdult.name: Adult Starting Ammunition: %d arrows
ShootingGalleryAmmoAdult.description: The ammunition at the start of the Shooting Gallery minigame as Adult.

CustomizeBombchuBowling.name: Customize Behavior
CustomizeBombchuBowling.description: Turn on/off changes to the Bombchu Bowling behavior.

BombchuBowlingNoSmallCucco.name: Remove Small Cucco
BombchuBowlingNoSmallCucco.description: Prevents the small Cucco from appearing in the Bombchu Bowling minigame.

BombchuBowlingNoBigCucco.name: Remove Big Cucco
BombchuBowlingNoBigCucco.description: Prevents the big Cucco from appearing in the Bombchu Bowling minigame.

BombchuBowlingAmmo.name: Bombchu Count: %d bombchus
BombchuBowlingAmmo.description: The number of Bombchus available at the start of the Bombchu Bowling minigame.

BombchuBowlingFirstPrize.name: First Prize
BombchuBowlingFirstPrize.description: The prize the cycle starts on.

CustomizeHorsebackArchery.name: Customize Behavior
CustomizeHorsebackArchery.description: Turn on/off changes to the Horseback Archery minigame behavior.

InstantHorsebackArcheryWin.name: Instant Win
InstantHorsebackArcheryWin.description: Skips the Horseback Archery minigame, automatically awarding the prize.

HorsebackArcheryAlwaysScore.name: Always Score 100
HorsebackArcheryAlwaysScore.description: Every arrow that hits a target scores 100 points (inner ring) regardless of where it lands.

HorsebackArcheryAmmo.name: Arrow Count
