HorsebackArcheryAmmo.description: The number of arrows available at the start of the Horseback Archery minigame.

CustomizeFrogsOcarinaGame.name: Customize Behavior
CustomizeFrogsOcarinaGame.description: Turn on/off changes to the Frogs' Ocarina Game behavior.

FrogsUnlimitedFailTime.name: Unlimited Playback Time
FrogsUnlimitedFailTime.description: Removes the timer to play back the song.

FrogsModifyFailTime.name: Modify Note Timer: %dx
FrogsModifyFailTime.description: Adjusts the time allowed for playback before failing.

CustomizeOcarinaGame.name: Customize Behavior
CustomizeOcarinaGame.description: Turn on/off changes to the Lost Woods Ocarina Game behavior.

InstantOcarinaGameWin.name: Instant Win
InstantOcarinaGameWin.description: Skips the Lost Woods Ocarina Memory Game.

NoteSpeed.name: Note Play Speed: %dx
NoteSpeed.description: Adjust the speed that the Skull Kids play the notes.

StartingNotes.name: Number of Starting Notes: %d notes
StartingNotes.description: Adjust the number of notes the Skull Kids play to start the first round.

RoundOneNotes.name: Round One Notes: %d notes
RoundOneNotes.description: Adjust the number of notes you need to play to end the first round.

RoundTwoNotes.name: Round Two Notes: %d notes
RoundTwoNotes.description: Adjust the number of notes you need to play to end the second round.

RoundThreeNotes.name: Round Three Notes: %d notes
RoundThreeNotes.description: Adjust the number of notes you need to play to end the third round.

OcarinaUnlimitedFailTime.name: Unlimited Playback Time
OcarinaUnlimitedFailTime.description: Removes the timer to play back the song.

SkipAmyPuzzle.name: Solve Amy's Puzzle
SkipAmyPuzzle.description: Amy's block-pushing puzzle is instantly solved.

IngoRaceOnce.name: Number of Races
IngoRaceOnce.description: Number of races Link must win against Ingo to earn Epona. Only works if Link is riding Epona, not the other rideable horse.

CustomizeFishing.name: Customize Behavior
CustomizeFishing.description: Turn on/off changes to the Fishing behavior.

InstantFishing.name: Instant Fishing
InstantFishing.description: All fish will be caught instantly.

GuaranteeFishingBite.name: Guarantee Bite
GuaranteeFishingBite.description: When a line is stable, guarantee a bite. Otherwise use Default logic.

FishNeverEscape.name: Fish never Escape
FishNeverEscape.description: Once a hook has been set, Fish will never let go while being reeled in.

LoachesAlwaysAppear.name: Loaches always Appear
LoachesAlwaysAppear.description: Loaches will always appear in the fishing pond instead of every four visits.

SkipKeepConfirmation.name: Skip Keep Confirmation
SkipKeepConfirmation.description: The Pond Owner will not ask to confirm if you want to keep a smaller Fish.

AllHyruleLoaches.name: All Fish are Hyrule Loaches
AllHyruleLoaches.description:
Every fish in the Fishing Pond will always be a Hyrule Loach.

NOTE: This requires reloading the area.

MinimumFishWeightChild.name: Child Minimum Weight: %d lbs.
MinimumFishWeightChild.description: The minimum weight for the unique Fishing Reward as a child.

MinimumFishWeightAdult.name: Adult Minimum Weight: %d lbs.
MinimumFishWeightAdult.description: The minimum weight for the unique fishing reward as an adult.

FishingBlankB.name: Allow fishing with blank B
FishingBlankB.description: Allow fishing even when not having any item equipped on the B button, fixing a vanilla bug. Always enabled in randomizer.

DampeBothPrizes.name: Dampe's Race
DampeBothPrizes.description: Dampe awards both prizes on the first race, not just the Hookshot.

HorsebackArcheryBothPrizes.name: Horseback Archery
HorsebackArcheryBothPrizes.description: Link can win both Horseback Archery prizes in one attempt

BounceOffWalls.name: Bounce off Walls
BounceOffWalls.description: Allows Link to bounce off walls when linear velocity is high enough. This is relevant when frequently being knocked back by traps, CC, or in Anchor.

MirroredWorldMode.name: Mirrored World
MirroredWorldMode.description:
Mirrors the world horizontally:

 - Always: Always mirror the world.
 - Random: Randomly decide to mirror the world on each scene change.
 - Random (Seeded): Scenes are mirrored based on the current randomizer seed/file.
 - Dungeons: Mirror the world in Dungeons.
 - Dungeons (Vanilla): Mirror the world in Vanilla Dungeons.
 - Dungeons (MQ): Mirror the world in MQ Dungeons.
 - Dungeons Random: Randomly decide to mirror the world in Dungeons.
 - Dungeons Random (Seeded): Dungeons are mirrored based on the current randomizer seed/file.

IvanCoopModeEnabled.name: Ivan the Fairy (Coop Mode)
IvanCoopModeEnabled.description: Enables Ivan the Fairy. Player 2 can control Ivan and press the C-Buttons to use items and mess with Player 1!

DogFollowsEverywhere.name: Dogs Follow You Everywhere
DogFollowsEverywhere.description: Allows dogs to follow you anywhere you go, even if you leave the Market.

RupeeDash.name: Rupee Dash Mode
RupeeDash.description: Rupees reduce over time; Link suffers damage when the count hits 0.

RupeeDashScaling.name: Rupee Dash Wallet Scaling
RupeeDashScaling.description: The larger Link's wallet, the faster Rupees reduce.

RupeeDashInterval.name: Rupee Dash Interval: %d seconds
RupeeDashInterval.description: Interval between Rupee reduction in Rupee Dash Mode.

ShadowTag.name: Shadow Tag Mode
ShadowTag.description: A Wallmaster follows Link everywhere, don't get caught!

HurtContainer.name: Hurt Container Mode
HurtContainer.description:
Changes Heart Piece and Heart Container functionality.

 - Each Heart Container or full Heart Piece reduces Link's Hearts by 1.
 - Can be enabled retroactively after a File has already started.

Teleport.name: Teleport Traps
Teleport.description:
Where a Teleport Trap can send you. Off keeps them out of the trap pool.

Simple: Link's House and the six warp song pads.
Advanced: The same pool the randomizer uses when it shuffles spawns and warp songs.

LowHpAlarm.name: Mute Low HP Alarm
LowHpAlarm.description: Disable the low HP beeping sound.

DisableNaviCallAudio.name: Disable Navi Call Audio
DisableNaviCallAudio.description: Disables the voice audio when Navi calls you.

EnemyBGMDisable.name: Disable Enemy Proximity Music
EnemyBGMDisable.description: Disables the music change when getting close to enemies. Useful for hearing your custom music for each scene more often.

LeeverEnemyBGM.name: Enable Enemy Proximity Music for Leever
LeeverEnemyBGM.description: Plays the battle music when getting close to a Leever, like in Majora's Mask.

LostWoodsConsistentVolume.name: Disable Leading Music in Lost Woods
LostWoodsConsistentVolume.description: Disables the volume shifting in the Lost Woods. Useful for hearing your custom music in the Lost Woods if you don't need the navigation assitance the volume changing provides. If toggling this while in the Lost Woods, reload the area for the effect to kick in.

SeqNameNotification.name: Display Sequence Name in Notifications
SeqNameNotification.description: Emits a notification with the current song name whenever it changes. (does not apply to fanfares or enemy BGM).

RandomizeAudioGenModes.name: Automatically Randomize All Music and Sound Effects
RandomizeAudioGenModes.description:
Set when the music and sound effects is automaticly randomized:
- Manual: Manually randomize music or sound effects by pressing the 'Randomize all Groups' button
- On New Scene : Randomizes when you enter a new scene.
- On Rando Gen Only: Randomizes only when you generate a new randomizer.
- On File Load: Randomizes on File Load.
- On File Load (Seeded): Randomizes on file load based on the current randomizer seed/file.

ExperimentalOctaveDrop.name: Lower Octaves of Unplayable High Notes
ExperimentalOctaveDrop.description: Some custom sequences may have notes that are too high for the game's audio engine to play. Enabling this checkbox will cause these notes to drop a couple of octaves so they can still harmonize with the other notes of the sequence.

GamepadMapper.name: Open Gamepad Mapper
GamepadMapper.description: Build an SDL mapping for a gamepad the game does not recognize, or fix one that is mapped wrong. Saves to usergamepadmappings.txt.

SaveEditor.name: Popout Save Editor
SaveEditor.description: Enables the separate Save Editor Window.

HookDebugger.name: Popout Hook Debugger
HookDebugger.description: Enables the separate Hook Debugger Window.

CollisionViewer.name: Popout Collision Viewer
CollisionViewer.description: Enables the separate Collision Viewer Window.

ActorViewer.name: Popout Actor Viewer
ActorViewer.description: Enables the separate Actor Viewer Window.

DisplayListViewer.name: Popout Display List Viewer
DisplayListViewer.description: Enables the separate Display List Viewer Window.

ValueViewer.name: Popout Value Viewer
ValueViewer.description: Enables the separate Value Viewer Window.

MessageViewer.name: Popout Message Viewer
MessageViewer.description: Enables the separate Message Viewer Window.

SohGfxDebugger.name: Popout Gfx Debugger
SohGfxDebugger.description: Enables the separate Gfx Debugger Window.

CosmeticsEditor.name: Popout Cosmetics Editor Window
CosmeticsEditor.description: Enables the separate Cosmetics Editor Window.

AudioEditor.name: Popout Audio Editor Window
AudioEditor.description: Enables the separate Audio Editor Window.

GameplayStats.name: Popout Gameplay Stats Window
GameplayStats.description: Enables the separate Gameplay Stats Window.

TimeDisplayEnabled.name: Toggle Timers Window
TimeDisplayEnabled.description: Enables the separate Additional Timers Window.

PlandomizerEditor.name: Popout Plandomizer Window
PlandomizerEditor.description: Enables the separate Randomizer Settings Window.

ItemTrackerSettings.name: Popout Item Tracker Settings
ItemTrackerSettings.description: Enables the separate Item Tracker Settings Window.

EntranceTrackerSettings.name: Popout Entrance Tracker Settings
EntranceTrackerSettings.description: Enables the separate Entrance Tracker Settings Window.

CheckTrackerSettings.name: Popout Check Tracker Settings
CheckTrackerSettings.description: Enables the separate Check Tracker Settings Window.

HintTrackerSettings.name: Popout Hint Tracker Settings
HintTrackerSettings.description: Enables the separate Hint Tracker Settings Window.

InputViewerSettings.name: Popout Input Viewer Settings
InputViewerSettings.description: Enables the separate Input Viewer Settings Window.

ModMenu.name: Popout Mod Menu Window
ModMenu.description: Enables the separate Mod Menu Window.

MQSpoilers.name: Vanilla/MQ Dungeon Spoilers
MQSpoilers.description: If enabled, Vanilla/MQ dungeons will show on the tracker immediately. Otherwise, Vanilla/MQ dungeon locations must be unlocked.

HideUnshuffledShopChecks.name: Hide Unshuffled Shop Item Checks
HideUnshuffledShopChecks.description: If enabled, will prevent the tracker from displaying slots with non-shop-item shuffles.

AlwaysShowGSLocs.name: Always Show Gold Skulltulas
AlwaysShowGSLocs.description: If enabled, will show GS locations in the tracker regardless of tokensanity settings.

ShowLogic.name: Show Logic
ShowLogic.description: If enabled, will show a check's logic when hovering over it.

EnableAvailableChecks.name: Enable Available Checks
EnableAvailableChecks.description: If enabled, will show the checks that are available to be collected with your current progress.

HideFound.name: Hide Found Items
HideFound.description: Removes hints whose item you have already collected from the Journal, instead of dimming them and sorting them to the bottom.

ItemCountType.name: Ammo/Capacity Tracking
ItemCountType.description:
Customize what the numbers under each item are tracking.

Note: items without capacity upgrades will track ammo even in capacity mode

KeyCounts.name: Key Count Tracking
KeyCounts.description: Customize what numbers are shown for key tracking.

TriforcePieceCounts.name: Triforce Piece Count Tracking
TriforcePieceCounts.description: Customize what numbers are shown for triforce piece tracking.

HookshotIdentifier.name: Show Hookshot Identifiers
HookshotIdentifier.description: Shows an 'H' or an 'L' to more easily distinguish between Hookshot and Longshot.

OpenChestIdentifier.name: Show Open Chest Identifiers
OpenChestIdentifier.description: With progressive Shuffle Open Chest, shows an 'S' when only small chests can be opened and a 'B' once big chests can be opened too.

DebugEnabled.name: Debug Mode
DebugEnabled.description: Enables Debug Mode, allowing you to select maps with L + R + Z, noclip with L + D-pad Right, and open the debug menu with L on the pause screen.

DebugSaveFileMode.name: Debug Save File Mode
DebugSaveFileMode.description:
Changes the behavior of debug file select creation (creating a save file on slot 1 with debug mode on):
- Off: The debug save file will be a normal savefile.
- Vanilla: The debug save file will be the debug save file from the original game.
- Maxed: The debug save file will be a save file with all of the items & upgrades.

SkulltulaDebugEnabled.name: OoT Skulltula Debug
SkulltulaDebugEnabled.description:
Enables Skulltula Debug, when moving the cursor in the menu above various map icons (boss key, compass, map screen locations, etc.) will set the GS bits in that area.
USE WITH CAUTION AS IT DOES NOT UPDATE THE GS COUNT!

ResourceLogging.name: Resource logging
ResourceLogging.description: Logs some resources as XML when they're loaded in binary format.

LogLevel.name: Log Level
LogLevel.description: The log level determines which messages are printed to the console. This does not affect the log file output

BetterDebugWarpScreen.name: Better Debug Warp Screen
BetterDebugWarpScreen.description: Optimized Debug Warp Screen, with the added ability to choose entrances and time of day.

DebugWarpScreenTranslation.name: Debug Warp Screen Translation
DebugWarpScreenTranslation.description: Translate the Debug Warp Screen based on the game language.

gSimulatedInputLag.name: Simulated Input Lag: %d frames
gSimulatedInputLag.description: Buffers your inputs to be executed a specified amount of frames later.

gLowResMode.name: N64 Mode
gLowResMode.description: Sets the aspect ratio to 4:3 and lowers resolution to 240p, the N64's native resolution.

TimelessEquipment.name: Timeless Equipment
TimelessEquipment.description:
Allows any item to be equipped, regardless of age.
Also allows child to use adult strength upgrades.

NoRestrictItems.name: Unrestricted Items
NoRestrictItems.description: Allows you to use any item at any location

SuperTunic.name: Super Tunic
SuperTunic.description: Makes every tunic have the effects of every other tunic.

FireproofDekuShield.name: Fireproof Deku Shield
FireproofDekuShield.description: Prevents the Deku Shield from burning on contact with fire.

ShieldTwoHanded.name: Shield with Two-Handed Weapons
ShieldTwoHanded.description: This allows you to put up your shield with any two-handed weapon in hand except for Deku Sticks.

HookshotEverything.name: Hookshot Everything
HookshotEverything.description: Makes every surface in the game hookshotable.

NoClip.name: No Clip
NoClip.description: Allows you to walk through walls.

ClimbEverything.name: Climb Everything
ClimbEverything.description: Makes every surface in the game climbable.

MoonJumpOnL.name: Moon Jump on L
MoonJumpOnL.description: Holding L makes you float into the air.

NoRedeadFreeze.name: No ReDead/Gibdo Freeze
NoRedeadFreeze.description: Prevents ReDeads and Gibdos from being able to freeze you with their scream.

NoKeeseGuayTarget.name: Keese/Guay don't Target You
NoKeeseGuayTarget.description: Keese and Guay no longer target you and simply ignore you as if you were wearing the Skull Mask.

DisableSandstorm.name: Disable Haunted Wasteland Sandstorm
DisableSandstorm.description: Disables sandstorm effect in Haunted Wasteland.

EasyFrameAdvance.name: Easy Frame Advancing with Pause
EasyFrameAdvance.description: Continue holding START button when unpausing to only advance a single frame and then re-pause.

EasyISG.name: Easy ISG
EasyISG.description:
Passive Infinite Sword Glitch
It makes your sword's swing effect and hitbox stay active indefinitely.

EasyQPA.name: Easy QPA
EasyQPA.description: Gives you the glitched damage value of the quick put away glitch.

DropsDontDie.name: Drops Don't Despawn
DropsDontDie.description: Drops from enemies, grass, etc. don't disappear after a set amount of time.

NoFishDespawn.name: Fish don't Despawn
NoFishDespawn.description: Prevents fish from automatically despawning after a while when dropped.

NoBugsDespawn.name: Bugs don't Despawn
NoBugsDespawn.description: Prevents bugs from automatically despawning after a while when dropped.

TimeSync.name: Time Sync
TimeSync.description: Syncs the in-game time with the real world time.

Btn.name: Button Combination:
Btn.description:
Buttons that activate Speed Modifier 1.

If "Toggle modifier instead of holding" is off, hold this combo to apply the modifier.
If it is on, tap this combo to toggle the modifier on/off.

SaveStatePromise.name: I promise I have read the warning

SaveStatesEnabled.name: I understand, enable save states
SaveStatesEnabled.description: F5 to save, F6 to change slots, F7 to load

EnableBetaQuest.name: Enable Beta Quest
EnableBetaQuest.description: Turns on OoT Beta Quest. *WARNING*: This will reset your game!

BetaQuestWorld.name: Beta Quest World: %d
BetaQuestWorld.description:
Set the Beta Quest world to explore. *WARNING*: Changing this will reset your game!
Ctrl+Click to type in a value.

EnemyNameTags.name: Enemy Name Tags
EnemyNameTags.description: When viewers spawn enemies, the enemy will have a name tag above them with the viewer's name.

SpawnedEnemiesIgnoredIngame.name: Spawned Enemies Ignored Ingame

presets.title: Take a look at our presets!
presets.message:
Hey there! Ship comes with a ton of options, but none of them are on by default,
even in randomizer. If you haven't already, we highly recommend applying the
"Enhancements - Curated Randomizer" preset for a great, curated out of the
box rando experience.

Afterwards, consider taking a look at the rest of the ESC menu to further tweak
the experience to your liking!
